⚠ AND A SECOND AGENDA ITEM CLOSES WITH IT, item 7, DOCTRINE SELECTION FOR A CHARACTER WITH NO FACTION. The answer is that DOCTRINE AND FACTION ARE SEPARATE FIELDS AND THE SEPARATION IS THE POINT. A faction says WHO STARTS HOSTILE; a doctrine says HOW THEY FIGHT. A LONE BOUNTY HUNTER HAS NO FACTION AND A DOCTRINE; A CZERKA CLERK HAS A FACTION AND NO COMBAT DOCTRINE AT ALL. Binding them would have FORCED A FAKE FACTION ONTO EVERY UNAFFILIATED CHARACTER, which is exactly the kind of structural lie this project catches in the source games.

Two of AGENDA-RECORD-01s fifteen items closed by reading one document that was already in the corpus.

## PT-1279 — Alignment specified. ⚠ ALIGNMENT-01 WAS NEVER UNREACHABLE  IT IS IN force/, NOT rules/. Third wrong-place error this session

PLAY-STATE-01 3 was left deliberately unfinished and AGENDA-RECORD-01 listed alignment as the first blocking item, on the basis that ALIGNMENT-01 did not resolve to a file. IT RESOLVES FINE. IT IS AT force/ALIGNMENT-01-v2.md. The search that failed looked in rules/ only.

⚠ THAT IS THE THIRD WRONG-PLACE ERROR IN THIS SESSION and the second in two rulings  PT-1278 found FACTIONS-01 sitting unread in the corpus after deferring faction twice. METHOD-RECORD-01 names this family exactly: A CORRECTLY SCOPED SEARCH IN THE WRONG LOCATION LOOKS LIKE A VALID NEGATIVE. A find by filename would have taken one command and was not run.

AND THE DOCUMENT IS FULLY SPECIFIED, which makes the deferral pure loss. 1 gives A 0 TO 100 SCALE STARTING AT 50, and notes KOTOR USES THE SAME RANGE  confirmed via G_PC_Align_Val in globalcat.2da  SO A PLAYER FAMILIAR WITH THE GAMES READS THE NUMBER CORRECTLY WITH NO EXPLANATION. 1.1 gives SEVEN BANDS with dark and light power cost multipliers, compressed from KOTORs own forceadjust.2da eleven bands with the extremes matching exactly.

⚠⚠ AND 1.2 IS THE PART THAT CHANGES THE RECORD DESIGN: HYSTERESIS IS DIRECTIONAL. Movement AWAY from Neutral changes band IMMEDIATELY at the threshold; movement TOWARD Neutral requires THREE POINTS PAST IT. Falling into Committed Dark happens at 28; climbing back out requires reaching 31.

SO THE BAND IS A FUNCTION OF THE VALUE AND THE DIRECTION OF TRAVEL, WHICH MEANS THE PREVIOUS BAND IS AN INPUT. ⚠ THE DERIVATION IS NOT PURE. It is A FOLD OVER THE EVENT LOG rather than a lookup on the current value  and it is THE FIRST DERIVED VALUE IN PLAY-STATE-01 THAT GENUINELY REQUIRES REPLAY RATHER THAN ARITHMETIC. That is a real vindication of the projection model rather than a complication of it.

⚠ AND THE DOCUMENT CARRIES ITS OWN IMPLEMENTATION WARNING, reproduced in the spec because it is the kind that hides: IMPLEMENTING THIS AS A SYMMETRIC DEADBAND SILENTLY DISABLES MASTERY GAIN BY DRIFT AND PRODUCES ZERO BAND FLIPS IN TESTING, WHICH LOOKS LIKE SUCCESS. A bug whose symptom is nothing happening is exactly the kind this project logs as a silent no-op.

SPECIFIED: the VALUE is stored as an integer; THE BAND IS DERIVED AND NEVER STORED. Every shift is a PERMANENT event, and ⚠ ALIGNMENT HISTORY IS NOT COMPACTABLE  2.4s story shifts and 3s atonement routes both care WHAT HAPPENED, not just where you ended.

TWELVE AGENDA ITEMS REMAIN. ⚠ AND NONE OF THE THREE BLOCKING ITEMS WAS EVER GENUINELY BLOCKED  faction was unread, alignment was mislocated, and the reaction vocabulary is correctly deferred pending real work rather than blocked at all.

## PT-1280 — ⚠ A CHECK FOR FALSE ABSENCE CLAIMS. Three wrong-place errors in one session, and the tooling was already right

Owner ruled that the wrong-place failure needs a check so it cannot recur. Three instances this session, all mine, all one command from being avoided: FACTIONS-01 deferred twice as unread when it sat in rules/; ALIGNMENT-01 called unreachable when it is in force/; and the .mod files called shipped when the engine writes them.

⚠⚠ AND THE DIAGNOSIS IS NOT WHAT IT LOOKED LIKE. audit_docrefs.py ALREADY SEARCHES force/ AND NEVER FLAGGED ALIGNMENT-01, BECAUSE IT RESOLVES. THE TOOLING WAS CORRECT. What happened is that I ASSERTED A NEGATIVE WITHOUT RUNNING THE TOOL THAT WOULD HAVE REFUTED IT  and no check reads a CLAIM, they all read the CORPUS.

So the new check is aimed at the claim rather than the corpus: IF A DOCUMENT SAYS SOMETHING IS UNREACHABLE, MISSING, ABSENT, DOES NOT EXIST OR CANNOT BE FOUND  AND IT EXISTS  FAIL. scripts/check_absence_claims.py, wired blocking. It knows 238 documents across six directories and resolves a -v2 suffix to its base name, which is exactly the case that defeated me.

⚠ FOUR FALSE POSITIVES WERE FOUND AND FIXED RATHER THAN SUPPRESSED, and each taught the regex something real:

    THE DOCUMENT MUST BE THE SUBJECT, immediately before the verb.
    EMBODIMENT-01s carried assumes it does not exist  the subject is
    CARRIED, not the document.

    A QUOTED DEFECT LIST IS NOT A CLAIM. PORT-01 v2 line 331 quoting
    RULES-03 DOES NOT EXIST is a citation, not an assertion.

    THE DEFINITION X WAS MISSING names a PART, not a document.

    ⚠ AND is missing X IS AN INCOMPLETENESS CLAIM, NOT AN ABSENCE
    CLAIM. FEAT-SCHEDULE-01 is missing two rows is true and fine.
    So missing alone requires end-of-clause; unreachable does not.

One over-correction was caught in testing and fixed: applying the end-of-clause rule to ALL FOUR WORDS let is unreachable and blocks this escape, which is the exact sentence that started this. Three probes now verify both directions.

⚠ AND THE CHECK FOUND A REAL STALE CLAIM I HAD LEFT BEHIND ON ITS FIRST CLEAN RUN: RECORD-GAPS-01 still said ALIGNMENT-01 does not resolve to a file in this repository, written before PT-1279 and not updated by it. Fixed, and it is exactly the class of thing the check exists for  I corrected the ruling and left the document.

Gate now runs 45 checks.

## TRACE-87 — STUDY batch 5, behaviour layer. ⚠ THE OPERAND MOVED INTO THE CONTENT FILE AND THE OPERATOR STAYED IN CODE, and the hook table ATTACHMENT-01 needed

Every DLG in both games  1,167 K1 and 1,159 K2, 104,750 nodes and 150,344 links  plus every BIF script, both nwscript.nss, every LIP archive, and every script-bearing field on every object type.

⚠⚠ ONE GATE MECHANISM, TWO COMPLETELY DIFFERENT USES, AND THE DIFFERENCE IS THE MOST TRANSFERABLE FINDING IN THE STUDY. Both games gate a dialogue link with A COMPILED SCRIPT WHOSE RETURN VALUE OPENS IT  no data expressions, no named conditions. But:

    K1   72,337 links, 12,424 gated, 2,345 DISTINCT GATE SCRIPTS
         k_con_carthpm, k_con_bastpm  ONE BESPOKE SCRIPT PER SITUATION,
         roughly one per five gates
    K2   78,007 links, 12,303 gated, 509 DISTINCT
         c_local_notset 1454, c_global_eq 1293  GENERIC PARAMETERISED
         PRIMITIVES

⚠ AND THE ENGINE CHANGE THAT MADE IT POSSIBLE: K2 ADDED GetScriptParameter AND GetScriptStringParameter. K1 HAS NEITHER. The DLG link grew five int params, five more, and two string params to feed them.

FROM K2s SHIPPED SOURCE: c_global_eq is GetGlobalNumber(GetScriptStringParameter()) equals GetScriptParameter(1). So THE OPERAND MOVED INTO THE CONTENT FILE AND THE OPERATOR STAYED IN CODE. That is what took 2,345 scripts down to 509, and it is the one line worth taking to ENGINE-SPEC-03: THE OPERAND BELONGS IN THE CONTENT FILE EVEN IF THE OPERATOR DOES NOT.

⚠ WHAT A SCRIPT CAN REMEMBER, AND THE ASYMMETRY IS THE POINT. The complete persistent store: 819 global booleans bit-packed into 103 bytes, 376 GLOBAL NUMBERS AT ONE BYTE EACH so range 0 to 255, 5 locations, 2 strings, per-object flags by INTEGER SLOT, and one stage id per quest. ⚠ AGAINST 89 FUNCTIONS FOR CONSTRUCTING EFFECTS AND 251 FOR READING OBJECT STATE, THERE ARE TWO FOR VARIABLES.

THE WORKAROUND IS ELEGANT AND DOES NOT RELIEVE THE LIMIT: the globals NAME IS A STRING IN THE CONVERSATION FILE, passed as an argument, so the two string globals are never involved  THE STRING IS NOT RUNTIME STATE, IT IS AUTHORED DATA. But the name still has to resolve to a row in globalcat.2da, A GAME-WIDE PREDECLARED TABLE. ADDING ONE CAMPAIGN VARIABLE STILL EDITS A FILE EVERY OTHER CAMPAIGN SHARES. That is why c_local_notset is K2s single most common gate: HAS THIS NOT HAPPENED YET IS THE CHEAPEST QUESTION THE STORAGE CAN ANSWER.

⚠ SCRIPTS DO NOT YIELD, which corrects the natural reading of TRACE-85. Exactly THREE functions take an action parameter in either game  DelayCommand, AssignCommand, ActionDoCommand. A SCRIPT RUNS TO COMPLETION. What persists in ActionList is A CAPTURED CLOSURE, a fragment EXPLICITLY HANDED to the engine carrying its own bytecode and program counter. That is why the saved fragment was 106 KB. And it is NOT ADDRESSABLE  no name, cannot be cancelled selectively, cannot be inspected.

⚠⚠ THE COMPLETE HOOK TABLE, WHICH IS THE VOCABULARY ATTACHMENT-01 WAS MISSING: module 14, creature 14, door 14, placeable 15 in K1 and 16 in K2, trigger 7, encounter 5, area 4, store 1  and ITEMS 0, WAYPOINTS 0, SOUNDS 0. THREE OF NINE BLUEPRINT TYPES ARE COMPLETELY INERT.

⚠ TWO ESCAPE HATCHES, AND BOTH ARE SYMPTOMS RATHER THAN FEATURES: UserDefined, AN INTEGER-CODED EVENT SCRIPTS RAISE ON EACH OTHER, which is THE ONLY OPEN EXTENSION POINT; and HEARTBEAT, WHICH IS A POLL BECAUSE THERE IS NO EVENT FOR IT. Our reaction model excluded polling deliberately and this is the evidence for why.

⚠ AND CONVERSATION IS A FOURTH BINDING SURFACE: 150,344 GATED LINKS AND 104,750 SCRIPTABLE NODES  MORE ATTACHMENT POINTS THAN EVERY OBJECT HOOK IN THE GAME COMBINED. Dialogue is not one system among several; it is where most behaviour actually lives.

VOICE, CLOSING BATCH 2s OPEN QUESTION: K2 MOVED IT TO THE DIALOGUE NODE and K1 had it in BOTH places. K1 nodes carry VO_ResRef 5,346 and Sound 118; K2 carries VO_ResRef 4,332 and SOUND ZERO. K2 abandoned the Sound field and dropped the TLK copy  a NORMALISATION and the right direction, since THE TLK IS GAME-GLOBAL AND THE NODE IS WHERE THE LINE IS.

⚠ ONE RESREF, THREE ASSETS: VO_ResRef locates the AUDIO and the LIP TRACK, while text comes separately by StrRef. Confirmed 15,126 times in K1 and 15,377 in K2.

⚠ AND BATCH 1s lips/*.mod PUZZLE RESOLVES: THOSE ARE SHIPPED, built at release. ONLY modules/*.mod ARE RUNTIME-WRITTEN. THE EXTENSION COLLIDES; THE PROVENANCE DOES NOT  which sharpens TRACE-86s retraction rather than undermining it.

FURTHER: SOURCE SHIPS  1,774 NSS beside 1,784 NCS in K1s BIF  but MODULE SCRIPTS ARE COMPILED ONLY. NCS CARRIES A BIG-ENDIAN LENGTH FIELD where every other format in the study is little-endian. And ⚠ CONVERSATION TOPOLOGY IS POSITIONAL  links hold ARRAY INDICES, so INSERTING A LINE RENUMBERS EVERYTHING PAST IT, and K2 SHIPS NodeID BUT THE RUNTIME STILL USES Index. Position-as-identity again, in the layer with the most content.

## TRACE-88 — STUDY batch 6, presentation. ⚠⚠ THERE IS NO CUTSCENE FORMAT. A cutscene is a conversation with cameras, and THE UNIT OF TIME IS ONE LINE OF DIALOGUE

Every audio directory in both games, 36,000+ files, every movie, all 2,326 DLGs re-read for presentation fields, every CameraList, 4,002 LIP files.

⚠⚠ THE CENTRAL QUESTION IS ANSWERED AND THE ANSWER IS THE SIMPLE ONE. NO DISTINCT CUTSCENE RESOURCE TYPE EXISTS in either game. IFOs Mod_CutSceneList is declared on every module and IS LENGTH 0 IN ALL 239. EVERY IN-ENGINE CUTSCENE IN BOTH GAMES IS A DLG WITH CAMERA FIELDS SET.

⚠ AND THE CONSEQUENCE IS SHARPER THAN THE FACT: THE UNIT OF TIME IS ONE LINE OF DIALOGUE. No timeline, no tracks. ANYTHING SHORTER THAN A LINE  a beat, an overlap, a reaction landing mid-sentence  HAS NOWHERE TO BE EXPRESSED. man26_trial, the Manaan trial, has 223 NODES CARRYING A CameraID: a timeline written one line at a time.

THAT ONE FACT EXPLAINS THREE THINGS AT ONCE, which is what makes it a real finding rather than a detail. WHY CameraList HAS NO BLUEPRINT  a viewpoint has NOTHING SHAREABLE TO TEMPLATE, every field being a coordinate or a lens setting, so the formats one blueprintless object is blueprintless FOR A PRINCIPLED REASON. WHY ANIMATION IS ABSENT on 94.4% of K1 nodes and 96.2% of K2  most conversation is two people standing still. And WHY THE SCRIPT API NEEDS CutsceneAttack AND CutsceneMove  the actors are ORDINARY CREATURES BEING PUPPETEERED and their normal AI would interfere.

⚠ LIP DECODED, closing batch 5s open item: 5-byte entries are FLOAT32 TIMESTAMP PLUS UINT8 SHAPE ID. Verified across all 4,002 files  zero stride mismatches, times strictly ascending and within the declared duration, and SHAPE IDS OCCUPYING EXACTLY 0 TO 15 in both games. It is A 16-VISEME TIMELINE. Which phoneme each id means lives in the model layer and stays open.

⚠ AnimList DECODED: Animation int plus Participant string, where Animation is A dialoganimations.2da ROW INDEX PLUS 10000  10040 is row 40 Talk_Forceful at 954 uses, 10042 is Talk_Sad at 508. THE TWO MOST-USED DIALOGUE ANIMATIONS BEING TALK FORCEFULLY AND TALK SADLY IS WHAT MAKES THE MAPPING SAFE TO ASSERT. Participant is an actor TAG with two reserved words, OWNER and PLAYER. ⚠ HONEST CAVEAT KEPT: a SECOND numbering base appears in the same field in the 1000s, marked INFERRED and unverified, and the script APIs ANIMATION_ constants are 0-999, A THIRD SCHEME. THREE NUMBERING SYSTEMS FOR ONE CONCEPT.

AUDIO IS FOUR LOCATIONS AND MOSTLY NOT WAV. ⚠ THE SPLIT IS LATENCY AND LIFETIME, NOT FORMAT: the BIF holds SHORT CUES NEEDED INSTANTLY, the stream directories hold LONG AUDIO PLAYED ONCE. And ⚠ VOICE AND MUSIC OPEN RIFF WITH A DECLARED CHUNK SIZE OF FIFTY BYTES against files running to megabytes  IT IS MP3 BEHIND A 58-BYTE STUB HEADER. streamsounds do not bother: raw MPEG frame sync with a LAME tag. ONE EXTENSION, TWO CONTAINERS, NEITHER OF THEM WAV.

K1 nests voice by module and SPEAKER, K2 by module and TOPIC  but ⚠ NOTHING IN THE DATA EVER NAMES A PATH. Addressing is by bare resref, SO THE DIRECTORIES ARE ORGANISATION FOR HUMANS ONLY.

⚠ UTS IS THE GOOD DESIGN AND CONNECTS TO BATCH 3: 25 ALWAYS-PRESENT FIELDS, THE ONLY BLUEPRINT TYPE WITH NO OPTIONAL FIELDS, and it can loop, fire at random intervals with variance, restrict to certain hours, pick from ten sounds and position randomly in a rectangle WITH NO SCRIPT. Ambience is data all the way down.

MUSIC BY CONTRAST HAS THREE SLOTS  MusicDay, MusicNight, MusicBattle  and the engines ENTIRE automatic behaviour is PICKING BETWEEN THEM ON TWO CONDITIONS. No transition graph, no layering, no cue system; THE COMPOSERS STRUCTURE LIVES IN THE AUDIO FILE. ⚠ AND THE CONTRAST IS THE FLAW: there IS a declarative mixer for EFFECTS  priorityGroups.2da, 27 groups with priority, volume, simultaneous cap, interrupt rule and fade time  AND NOTHING EQUIVALENT FOR THE SCORE.

MOVIES are Bink, named directly from script. ⚠ movies.2da IS NOT THE PLAYBACK INDEX  its columns are title, description, alwaysshow, order, and its row count matches NEITHER games file count. IT IS THE BONUS-FEATURE GALLERY, AND THE NAME INVITES EXACTLY THE WRONG READING.

K1 vs K2, the budget shifted: K2 spent on PRERENDERED VIDEO, 607MB to 1,600MB for only 10% more files, and on PER-LINE FACIAL PERFORMANCE adding FacialAnim, Emotion and PlayOverlayAnimation  and FAR LESS on hand-directed in-engine work, AnimatedCut dropping from 20 files to 4 and stunt models from 24 to 4. ⚠ AND K2 GIVES A LINE FOUR INDEPENDENT PRESENTATION CHANNELS  body, face, mood, lip  WITH FOUR NUMBERING SCHEMES AND NO SHARED TIMELINE. The lip track is the only one with real timing, AND IT IS NOT EVEN REFERENCED FROM THE NODE; it is found by SHARING A NAME WITH THE AUDIO.

## TRACE-89 — STUDY batch 7, toolset and game. ⚠⚠ NOTHING IS LOST ON THE WAY OUT BECAUSE THERE IS NO WAY OUT. The study is complete

Final batch. The toolset IS installed  nwtoolset.exe, nwhak.exe, GFFEditor.exe  as Windows binaries on a Linux install, so their STRINGS were read and THEY WERE NEVER RUN. Every behavioural claim rests on artifacts they produced or on binary literals, and each record says which. What was read properly is better material than the shipped game gives: 16 official campaign modules, 14 community modules, 18 haks, 4 custom TLKs, a 1,389-file override, 30 modules opened in full  AUTHORED ARTIFACTS, which is the right sample for this question.

⚠ SAVE, NOT EXPORT. The toolset works DIRECTLY ON THE .mod and there is NO SEPARATE PROJECT FORMAT. Five independent lines: the module carries NSS SOURCE; it carries GIC COMMENT FILES THE GAME IGNORES; it carries nine ITP palettes plus Mod_CacheNSSList and Mod_Creator_ID; the file dialogs know only .mod, .git, .dlg and .nss with NO PROJECT EXTENSION; and it carries AutoBackup and Create Backup Modules. YOU BACK UP THE THING YOU ARE WORKING ON.

⚠⚠ AND THE QUESTION FLAGGED AS MOST IMPORTANT IS ANSWERED DECISIVELY. 26,317 NSS AGAINST 26,180 NCS ACROSS 30 MODULES. 93% OF NWN MODULES CARRY THEIR SOURCE, and the only two that do not contain no scripts at all. Every official campaign module carries it. NOTHING IS LOST ON THE WAY OUT BECAUSE THERE IS NO WAY OUT.

⚠ AND KOTOR IS THE COUNTER-EXAMPLE, DELIBERATELY. EVERY ONE of its 10,861 K1 and 4,508 K2 MODULE SCRIPTS IS COMPILED-ONLY  WHILE BIOWARE KEPT SOURCE FOR THEIR OWN 1,774 BIF SCRIPTS. So the decision was deliberate AND APPLIED PRECISELY WHERE REOPENING MATTERS MOST. That is a one-way door, and it is why TWENTY YEARS OF KOTOR COMMUNITY WORK HAS BEEN DECOMPILATION WHERE NWNs HAS BEEN EDITING.

⚠ THE NARROW LESSON FOR OUR BUILDER, and it is not a format lesson: WHAT MAKES AN NWN MODULE REOPENABLE IS NOT A CLEVER FORMAT, IT IS THE DECISION TO PUT THE SOURCE IN THE ARTIFACT. Cost is roughly 2x on the script layer  A ROUNDING ERROR AGAINST AN 866 MB MODELS BIF.

MODULE-LOCAL EVERYTHING, and the mechanism is identical five times over: QUESTS as module.jrl inside the module, 1-50 each. RULES via haks  wc_2da_shared.hak carries 30 2DAs INCLUDING classes AND THE PER-CLASS FEAT TABLES. STRINGS via Mod_CustomTlk. ⚠ VARIABLES AS VarTable, NAME, TYPE AND VALUE  NAMED AND TYPED  against KOTORs entire campaign memory of 819 bits, 376 single-byte numbers and TWO STRINGS, all predeclared game-wide. And AREAS AT 1 TO 314 PER MODULE where KOTOR is ALWAYS EXACTLY 1.

⚠ THE MECHANISM WORTH TAKING IS THE SAME IN ALL FIVE ROWS: A MODULE DECLARES WHAT IT NEEDS, BY NAME, IN ITS MANIFEST. NOTHING IS DISCOVERED BY SCANNING A FOLDER.

⚠ AND PRECEDENCE IS ONE ORDERED FIELD. Mod_HakList, an ordered list of hak names, with _top at index 0 and _core at the bottom in two unrelated projects. Compare batch 1: KOTOR HAS FOUR SHADOWING LAYERS AND NOTHING DECLARES THEIR ORDER, and TWO BATCHES WENT AT IT AND CLOSED IT AS NOT DETERMINABLE. THE SAME QUESTION HERE IS ANSWERED BY READING ONE FIELD. That is the cost of putting a rule in code rather than in data, stated as precisely as this study can state anything.

⚠ THE HONEST COMPARISON, ITEM 7. MANIFEST DIFF: 42 SHARED FIELDS, 9 NWN-ONLY, 1 KOTOR-ONLY. KOTOR INHERITED THE FORMAT, REMOVED NINE CAPABILITIES AND ADDED ONE. And four flaws this study recorded INDEPENDENTLY across batches 2 and 4 TURN OUT TO BE ONE DECISION: REMOVING MODULE SCOPING.

⚠⚠ AND THE AGENT RECORDED THE OTHER DIRECTION UNPROMPTED, WHICH IS THE PART I MOST WANT KEPT: A STUDY THAT ONLY CATALOGUES REGRESSIONS WILL CONCLUDE THE OLDER TOOL WAS BETTER, AND ON TWO COUNTS IT WAS NOT. The modding machinery was DEAD WEIGHT FOR A GAME THAT SHIPPED NO TOOLSET  a defensible product decision AND bad architecture, both halves true. One area per module SUITS AN XBOX TARGET WITH BOUNDED LOADS, so the regression is real AND SO IS THE REASON. And Mod_VO_ID, KOTORs single addition, IS EARNED  13,860 and 17,098 voice files against NWNs largely unvoiced dialogue.

NWNs OWN FAULTS RECORDED TOO: hak precedence direction is A NAMING CONVENTION RATHER THAN A DECLARATION; GIC aligns comments BY ARRAY POSITION; and the custom-TLK selection rule is unwritten.

⚠⚠ THE LINE THAT MATTERS FOR THE BUILDER, quoted because it should not be paraphrased: AURORAS IMPORTANT PROPERTY IS NOT ANY FEATURE. IT IS THAT THE TOOL AND THE GAME READ THE SAME FILE, AND THAT FILE CARRIES EVERYTHING THE TOOL NEEDS TO RECONSTRUCT THE AUTHORS INTENT  SOURCE, COMMENTS, PALETTES, CONFIG  NONE OF WHICH THE ENGINE READS.

AND THE RULE THAT FOLLOWS: A BUILDER THAT WRITES WHAT OUR APP READS IS ONLY SAFE IF THE ARTIFACT ALSO CARRIES WHAT THE BUILDER NEEDS TO READ IT BACK.

## PT-1281 — AGENDA-DRAFTING-01 written. Eight documents in three tiers, and the study removed every reason to keep deferring the format

Owner asked what must be drafted before proper work can begin, now the seven-batch study is closed. THIS IS A DIFFERENT LIST FROM AGENDA-RECORD-01, and the distinction matters: that one holds TWELVE LOOSE ENDS from the record specs, none blocking. THIS ONE IS DOCUMENTS THAT DO NOT EXIST AND MUST, BEFORE ANYONE WRITES CODE.

TIER 1 IS THE FORMAT AND EVERYTHING WAITS ON IT. ⚠ THE PACKAGE FORMAT WAS DEFERRED AT PT-1248 AS A MUCH LARGER PROJECT, AND THE STUDY HAS NOW REMOVED EVERY REASON TO KEEP DEFERRING IT. Three findings define it and ALL THREE ARE DECISIONS RATHER THAN FORMATS: put the source in the artifact, which is the single difference between a community that edits and one that decompiles; a module DECLARES WHAT IT NEEDS BY NAME IN ITS MANIFEST, five things by one mechanism with nothing discovered by scanning a folder; and PRECEDENCE IS ONE ORDERED FIELD, where two study batches failed to determine KOTORs at all.

AND THE THING TO AVOID IS MEASURED: KOTOR INHERITED NWNs FORMAT, REMOVED NINE CAPABILITIES AND ADDED ONE, and four independently-recorded flaws turn out to be ONE DECISION  removing module scoping.

⚠ TIER 1 ALSO CARRIES A SECOND DOCUMENT THAT IS NOT THE FORMAT: THE BUILDER-APP CONTRACT. The format says what a package IS; this says WHAT THE BUILDER MUST WRITE THAT THE APP NEVER READS  comments, palettes, editor config, source. TRACE-89s line stands as its thesis: A BUILDER THAT WRITES WHAT OUR APP READS IS ONLY SAFE IF THE ARTIFACT ALSO CARRIES WHAT THE BUILDER NEEDS TO READ IT BACK.

TIER 2 IS WHAT A VERTICAL SLICE NEEDS. THE EVENT KINDS, which PLAY-STATE-01 left as four lifetimes with no vocabulary and which ATTACHMENT-01s reaction model is blocked on  and TRACE-87 supplies real evidence in KOTORs hook table, ⚠ INCLUDING THAT TWO OF ITS HOOKS ARE SYMPTOMS RATHER THAN MODELS: UserDefined as the only open extension point, and HEARTBEAT AS A POLL BECAUSE THERE IS NO EVENT FOR IT. THE QUEST AND CONCLUSION MODEL, whose four decisions are locked at PT-1276 and whose document does not exist. And THE DIALOGUE AND CUTSCENE SURFACE, where ⚠ TRACE-88 established THERE IS NO CUTSCENE FORMAT and THE UNIT OF TIME IS ONE LINE OF DIALOGUE  a limit we should inherit or reject DELIBERATELY, since it bought KOTOR one authoring surface instead of two.

TIER 3 IS NEEDED BEFORE CODE RATHER THAN BEFORE DESIGN: ⚠ THE TESTING SPEC, because THE GATE RUNS 45 CHECKS ON DOCUMENTS AND NONE ON CODE, and it should be written BEFORE THE FIRST MODULE RATHER THAN AFTER THE TENTH. The presentation layer, gated on one question  DOES A CHARACTER ON OUR SCREEN EVER MOVE. And the data extraction, specified at CHARGEN-DATA-01 and never run.

⚠ AND THE DOCUMENT STATES WHAT IS NOT ON IT, WHICH IS AS USEFUL: AGENDA-RECORD-01s twelve items are real and non-blocking; settings scope, quickbar and map remain deferred by owner ruling; THE KOTOR EXPORTER IS DECLINED AND IS NOT A HOPE WORTH CARRYING; and ⚠ THE STUDYS 63 CATALOGUED FLAWS ARE EVIDENCE, NOT TASKS  the seven OF entries were about OUR format and are CLOSED by PT-1272 through PT-1275.

⚠ ONE ITEM CARRIES A CLOCK: THE HANDOFF TOKEN CAME THROUGH A CHAT TRANSCRIPT. The study agent confirmed it is not written into any repo file and recommended rotating rather than waiting for expiry. IT IS THE ONLY OUTSTANDING ITEM THAT GETS WORSE WITH TIME.

## PT-1282 — PACKAGE-NAMING-01 written. Path is identity, tag is instance, name is display  and KOTORs terse names were a 16-CHARACTER LIMIT, not a philosophy

First piece of the package format. Owner wanted intuitive naming that makes things findable, explicitly not following the games.

⚠ THE FINDING THAT REFRAMED THE WHOLE CONVERSATION: KOTORs blstrpstol01 IS NOT A NAMING PHILOSOPHY. baseitems.2da ALREADY CARRIES READABLE LABELS  Droid_Computer_Spike_Mount_x at 28 characters  WHILE ITS RESREFS TOP OUT AT 15. A RESREF IS A FILENAME INSIDE AN ARCHIVE and was capped at 16. THEY WERE NOT CHOOSING TERSE NAMES; THEY WERE CHOOSING NAMES THAT FIT. We have no such constraint, which changes the question from should names be readable to what is a name FOR.

THREE CONCEPTS, THREE WORDS, where KOTOR distinguished two and collapsed the third into a global string table. PATH is identity of a DEFINITION and where it lives. TAG is identity of a PLACED INSTANCE. NAME is what a PLAYER READS. ⚠ path rather than handle because IT IS A PATH  the word needs no explaining, and it makes IDENTITY AND LOCATION THE SAME THING, which is where findability comes from for free.

⚠ THE PATH SAYS WHAT A THING IS, NOT WHAT IT IS WORTH. An earlier sketch went items/armor/chest/light  but WEIGHT CLASS IS A STAT THAT GETS TUNED, and moving an item from light to medium during balancing would move the file and break every reference. So slot and weight are FIELDS. And the Builder can still DISPLAY four levels of grouping, because A VIEW COSTS NOTHING AND BREAKS NOTHING.

⚠ PATH IS IDENTITY AND THE FILE KNOWS ITS OWN PATH  option D, chosen by owner. Three safeguards: a Builder move is ONE OPERATION that rewrites references; EVERY FILE CARRIES ITS OWN PATH AS A FIELD so a hand-moved file is SELF-DESCRIBING; and a broken reference FAILS LOUDLY.

⚠ AND LOUD FAILURE IS A RULE RATHER THAN A PREFERENCE, on the studys F35: KOTORs ENGINE WROTE AN APPEARANCE INDEX PAST THE END OF THE TABLE IT INDEXES AND NOTHING REJECTED THE WRITE. A silent bad reference is worse than a loud broken one, AND WE ARE INVITING MODDERS INTO THE RAW FOLDER.

⚠ AREAS ARE NUMBERED AND NOTHING ELSE IS  a deliberate exception and the one seam in the document. Areas get it because a campaigns areas have A CANONICAL PLAY ORDER, there are few enough that renumbering is survivable, and MODDERS READ RAW FOLDERS WHERE ALPHABETICAL ORDER IS USELESS. Nothing else does because THERE IS NO FIRST VIBROBLADE. The cost is accepted explicitly: a number in a name is position-as-identity, WHICH THE STUDY FOUND FATAL FIVE TIMES, most vividly in K2 shipping BountyHunter(CUT!!!) because deleting the row would renumber the world. So an inserted area gets a03 OUT OF SEQUENCE and the manifest carries the real order.

NO AUTO-NUMBERED DUPLICATES. vibroblade(01) and vibroblade(02) IS blstrpstol01 WITH NICER PUNCTUATION  the exact thing the owner objected to. The Builder refuses and asks for a real name, because A SECOND THING NEEDING THE SAME NAME IS A SIGNAL THE FIRST WAS NAMED BADLY.

SCOPING IS RELATIVE PATHS WITH DECLARED DEPENDENCIES, per TRACE-89: A MODULE DECLARES WHAT IT NEEDS, BY NAME, IN ITS MANIFEST. ⚠ And TRACE-82s finding is the reason: KOTOR HAS NO MODULE-LOCAL RULES TABLE, NOT ONE, IN EITHER GAME, so a campaign could not change a rule without changing it for every campaign installed.

⚠ AND ONE THING DELIBERATELY REFUSED: NO PER-FILE KOTOR EXPORT METADATA. Owner floated it; declined on the studys own evidence. FOUR DEAD CAPABILITIES WERE FOUND  racialtypes adjust columns with every value zero in both games, LawfulChaotic dropped from live records, Mod_CutSceneList length 0 in all 239 modules, and unvalidated SkillList slots. A kotor_baseitem field on every item, for an exporter DECLINED AT PT-1269, is how the fifth gets born. If a mapping is ever wanted IT BELONGS IN ONE TABLE, which can be validated as a unit and deleted cleanly where metadata on a thousand files cannot.

## PT-1283 — QUEST-MODEL-01 written. A quest has NO POSITION  it has a SET OF NAMED FLAGS, and a conclusion is which ending fired

The four decisions were locked at PT-1276 on TRACE-86s evidence. This is the document they were waiting for, and PT-1267 named it as cross-campaign carrys central unknown: WHAT A QUEST CONCLUSION IS AS A RECORDABLE THING. A LATER CAMPAIGN CAN ONLY ASK ABOUT WHAT THIS DOCUMENT DECIDES TO RECORD.

CHECKED FIRST, per the lesson from clusters B and C: nothing in the corpus defines a quests shape. ENGINE-SPEC-02 has QUEST DENSITY at 5c and CANON-01-v2 has dispositions, but no structure. So this is genuinely new rather than a generalisation.

⚠ ONE OF KOTORS FOUR PROPERTIES IS RIGHT AND IS TAKEN: QUESTS ARE NAME-ADDRESSED, used by script, save and UI alike, and NEARLY UNIQUE IN A GAME WHERE ALMOST EVERYTHING ELSE IS A ROW INDEX.

THE OTHER THREE ARE REJECTED. ⚠ A QUEST HAS NO POSITION. It has A SET OF NAMED FLAGS, each an outcome that either happened or did not. KOTORs single integer works because a quest is a LINEAR STRING OF AUTHORED STAGES; ours are not. A quest with two independent threads HAS NO SINGLE POSITION, and the moment a campaign wants they allied with the Beks AND spared Brejik, ONE INTEGER CANNOT HOLD IT. That is THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN CARRYING AN OUTCOME AND CARRYING A BOOKMARK.

⚠⚠ A CONCLUSION IS A NAMED OUTCOME, NEVER A COMPLETION BOOLEAN, and this is the decision everything rests on. A QUEST DOES NOT END  IT ACCUMULATES FLAGS, AND SOME FLAGS ARE MARKED AS CONCLUSIONS, meaning this quest reached a resting point and THIS IS WHICH ONE. A later campaign asks WHICH CONCLUSION FIRED, NOT WHETHER ONE DID.

KOTOR PROVES THE FAILURE IN ITS OWN SHIPPED DATA: with End set on NINE STAGES OF ONE QUEST, did they resolve it returns YES AND TEACHES A SEQUEL NOTHING. FOR CROSS-CAMPAIGN CARRY, WHICH ENDING HAPPENED IS THE ENTIRE PAYLOAD.

NO ORDINAL COMPARISON, DELIBERATELY. TRACE-86 found stage ids are LABELS RATHER THAN ORDINALS  a limitation for KOTOR, CORRECT FOR US. If a conclusion is a named outcome rather than a position, FURTHER ALONG IS NOT A MEANINGFUL QUESTION, and building comparability in would push us back toward the linear model we are rejecting. WE ASK WHAT HAPPENED, NOT HOW FAR DID THEY GET. ⚠ A package that wants ordering MAY DECLARE ONE  an authored list for a progress display  BUT THAT IS A VIEW AND MUST NOT BE THE MODEL.

⚠ WHAT CROSSES A CAMPAIGN BOUNDARY IS NOT THE QUEST, IT IS THE CONCLUSIONS. And AN ABSENT CONCLUSION IS A FACT AND MUST BE CARRIED AS ONE  they never resolved the Leviathan is DIFFERENT FROM we have no record, and a later package may want to know which. Absent-not-zeroed, per CHARACTER-RECORD-01. Flags below conclusion level are package-scoped and do not cross by default; a package MAY DECLARE ADDITIONAL FLAGS AS CARRIED, per flag.

SCOPING IS PACKAGE-RELATIVE. ⚠ KOTORS JOURNAL IS A SINGLE GAME-WIDE FILE with quests as categories inside it, so TWO CAMPAIGNS COLLIDE BY CONSTRUCTION. And TRACE-89 showed the alternative SHIPPING IN THE SAME ENGINE FAMILY: NWN modules carry module.jrl INSIDE THE MODULE, 1 to 50 quests each. THE CAPABILITY EXISTED; KOTOR REMOVED IT.

⚠ AND ONE OPEN ITEM WORTH FLAGGING NOW: PT-1253 LOCKED THE JOURNAL SCREEN AGAINST A STAGE MODEL. The sort row and quest list WILL NEED REVISITING against a flag model  a locked screen now disagrees with a new spec, which is the same shape as EMBODIMENT-01s lattice-versus-flat-list disagreement.

## PT-1284 — Quest authoring model. ⚠ FLAGS ARE NEVER UNSET, which makes the cascade problem disappear

Owner raised that flags may need ordering, and that some flags might be sub-flags whose state depends on a parent  when the parent changes, the children may or may not remain. That instinct identified a real problem and the proposed mechanism was heavier than the problem needs.

⚠⚠ THE RESOLUTION IS ONE RULE: FLAGS RECORD WHAT HAPPENED AND ARE NEVER UNSET. You allied with Gadon. Later you betrayed him. BOTH ARE TRUE  the betrayal FOLLOWS the alliance, it does not undo it.

AND THAT IS WHAT MAKES THE CASCADE PROBLEM DISAPPEAR. When a parent changes, do the children remain ONLY ARISES IF FLAGS CAN BE TAKEN AWAY. THEY CANNOT, SO THERE IS NOTHING TO CASCADE. This is PLAY-STATE-01s permanent lifetime applied to quests, and it also keeps the record honest  a sequel asking DID THEY WORK WITH THE BEKS gets the right answer regardless of how it ended.

⚠ PROSE IS PER FLAG, NOT PER COMBINATION, and this is the number that answers the owners complexity worry. THREE INDEPENDENT YES/NO FACTS NEED EIGHT STAGES IN KOTORS MODEL, ONE PER COMBINATION, AND THREE FLAGS IN OURS. The saving GROWS with every fact added. So the authoring burden is LESS than a stage model, not more  which is the opposite of what it looks like at first.

An override exists for prose on a specific combination, where the writing genuinely needs it. PROGRESSIVE DISCLOSURE  the simple case stays simple and NOBODY PAYS FOR THE HARD CASE UNLESS THEY USE IT.

TWO MECHANISMS, BOTH SMALL. ORDER: the author lists flags in reading order  A LIST, NOT A TREE, NOTHING TO CONFIGURE. SUPERSESSION: a flag may name earlier flags it replaces IN THE JOURNAL, so betrayed-the-beks supersedes allied-with-gadon and the journal shows the betrayal while BOTH REMAIN RECORDED.

⚠ NO IMPLICIT CHAINS. If A supersedes B and B supersedes C, A DOES NOT SUPERSEDE C. State it or it does not happen. Implicit transitivity is EXACTLY the undeclared coupling the study kept finding broken  TRACE-82s class-prefix convention that APPEARS NOWHERE IN classes.2da is the same failure.

⚠ A HIERARCHY WAS CONSIDERED AND REJECTED, and the reason is authoring cost: PARENT/CHILD WITH PER-FLAG RETENTION RULES MEANS EVERY FLAG NEEDS A RULE ABOUT EVERY FLAG IT RELATES TO. Ordering plus supersession handles the common case WITH NO CONFIGURATION AT ALL and the rare case with ONE EXPLICIT LINE.

GROUPING IS A BUILDER VIEW AND ONLY THAT  it may collapse flags under headings for browsability and MEANS NOTHING TO THE MODEL. ⚠ THE MOMENT GROUPING AFFECTS BEHAVIOUR, THE HIERARCHY HAS BEEN BUILT AFTER ALL.

⚠ AND WHAT THIS DOES NOT SOLVE, STATED RATHER THAN HIDDEN: FORTY FLAGS IS STILL FORTY FLAGS. Ordering makes them READABLE, not FEWER. KOTORS STAGE MODEL PREVENTED SPRAWL BY CONSTRUCTION AND OURS DOES NOT. That wants a SOFT WARNING IN THE BUILDER rather than a hard limit.

Closes QUEST-MODEL-01s open item on whether a flag can be unset.

## TRACE-90 — Item census. ⚠ TWO-LEVEL PATHS SURVIVE 9,178 REAL ITEMS WITH ZERO COLLISIONS  and the real risk is the CATCH-ALL, not depth

The one judgement PACKAGE-NAMING-01 could not evidence was path depth. It is now evidenced, and the census found a different risk we would have walked into.

⚠⚠ THE COLLISION TEST IS DECISIVE. Every items readable label in both games mapped onto kind/subkind/name: 4,178 ITEMS IN K1 AND 5,000 IN K2, ZERO COLLISIONS. And flattening to a SINGLE level still gives only 6 collisions in K1, 0.14%, AND ZERO IN K2. TWO LEVELS HAS MARGIN. The open item closes.

⚠ HONEST CAVEAT KEPT, and it matters: BioWares labels were already close to unique BECAUSE MANY WERE GENERATED FROM RESREFS. So the test proves the SCHEME survives a real catalogue; it does not prove HUMAN-CHOSEN names would collide as rarely. Recorded rather than glossed.

AND THE VOLUME FEAR WAS UNFOUNDED. The distribution is EXTREMELY LOPSIDED  Misc 42%, Armor 24%, and WEAPONS ONLY 12%. So items/weapons/ holds roughly 500 files in a game the size of K1, not four thousand. Browsable.

⚠⚠ THE FINDING THAT CHANGES THE SPEC IS NOT ABOUT DEPTH AT ALL. BIOWARES OWN CATCH-ALL PREFIX g_ COVERS 55.9% OF PREFIXED ITEMS IN K1. OVER HALF THEIR CATALOGUE LIVES UNDER UNCLASSIFIED. A misc/ folder is not a harmless escape hatch  IT BECOMES THE PATH OF LEAST RESISTANCE AND SWALLOWS THE CATALOGUE. So misc/ MUST NOT EXIST AS A DEFAULT: either it does not exist, or choosing it is A DELIBERATE ACT THE BUILDER MAKES SLIGHTLY AWKWARD.

BIOWARE DID HAVE A TAXONOMY  they expressed it as A NAMING CONVENTION RATHER THAN A STRUCTURE. Seven top-level prefixes applied at 91.4% and 90.1% consistency, and w_ alone carries TWENTY weapon subcategories. ⚠ SO THEIR CONVENTION IS EFFECTIVELY OUR TWO-LEVEL PATH, WRITTEN INTO A 16-CHARACTER FILENAME BECAUSE THEY HAD NOWHERE ELSE TO PUT IT. That is corroboration rather than coincidence.

⚠ AND ITEMS OUTNUMBER AREAS 24 TO 1 IN K1 AND 45 TO 1 IN K2. That is the strongest available support for PT-1282s deliberate exception: NUMBERING AREAS IS SURVIVABLE BECAUSE THERE ARE FEW; NUMBERING ITEMS WOULD BE UNMANAGEABLE.

TWO SMALLER FINDINGS WORTH KEEPING. baseitems.2das itemclass IS NOT A CATEGORY  it is A RESREF PREFIX USED AT RUNTIME FOR MODEL LOOKUP, which is exactly the kind of field a later reader would mistake for a taxonomy. And the upgrade-slot columns are FIVE COLUMNS ALL ZERO IN K1 AND USED IN K2  a dead capability that was later REVIVED, which is the first counter-example to the studys four-dead-capabilities pattern and worth noting as such.

## PT-1286 — PACKAGE-FORMAT-01 written. ⚠ A PACKAGE IS A FOLDER, THE MANIFEST DECLARES EVERYTHING, AND NOTHING IS DISCOVERED BY SCANNING

Tier 1 of AGENDA-DRAFTING-01 and the thing the seven-batch study was for. Deferred at PT-1248 as a much larger project; the study removed every reason to keep deferring it.

⚠ THE ONE SENTENCE: A PACKAGE IS A FOLDER. THE MANIFEST SAYS WHAT IS IN IT AND WHAT IT NEEDS. NOTHING IS DISCOVERED BY SCANNING. That is TRACE-89s central mechanism and the single thing NWN did that KOTOR removed.

WHY IT MATTERS MORE THAN IT SOUNDS, and the comparison is the studys sharpest: TRACE-81 SPENT TWO FULL BATCHES ON KOTORS PRECEDENCE AND CLOSED IT AS NOT DETERMINABLE  four shadowing layers with nothing declaring their order. TRACE-89 ANSWERED THE SAME QUESTION FOR NWN BY READING ONE FIELD. That is the cost of putting a rule in code rather than in data.

⚠ A FOLDER, NOT AN ARCHIVE, and the third reason decides it. git diff works. A modder can look, which PT-1282 already designs for. AND TRACE-86s RETRACTION IS IMPOSSIBLE HERE  two study batches concluded .mod files shipped when THE ENGINE WRITES THEM, because SHIPPED AND RUNTIME-WRITTEN FILES SAT SIDE BY SIDE IN ONE DIRECTORY AND THE FORMAT DID NOT DISTINGUISH THEM. A package folder is AUTHORED CONTENT ONLY.

⚠ THE LAYOUT CARRIES ONE FOLDER KOTOR DOES NOT HAVE: rules/. TRACE-82 found NO MODULE-LOCAL RULES TABLE IN EITHER GAME, NOT ONE, every archive under modules/ searched. A campaign could not say in my content this weapon hits harder without changing it for every campaign installed.

THE MANIFEST IS MODELLED ON NWNs, the only one in the study that works. ⚠ AND [requires].packages IS ORDERED, AND THAT ORDER IS THE PRECEDENCE  one list, later entries win, which is Mod_HakList. ⚠ NWNs OWN FLAW IS FIXED: TRACE-89 found ITS PRECEDENCE DIRECTION EXPRESSED AS A NAMING CONVENTION, _top and _core suffixes in two unrelated projects. A CONVENTION IS NOT A DECLARATION. Ours is positional and explicit.

AND [order] IS WHY NOTHING BUT AREAS CARRIES A NUMBER. The manifest holds the authoritative order, so an inserted area gets a03 OUT OF SEQUENCE and the manifest still knows the truth. ORDER IS A FIELD AND IS NEVER INFERRED FROM A NAME.

⚠⚠ SECTION 5 IS THE FORMAT RULE MOST LIKELY TO BE DROPPED AS AN OPTIMISATION, SO IT IS STATED AS A RULE: THE BUILDER WRITES MORE THAN THE APP READS. 26,317 SCRIPT SOURCES AGAINST 26,180 COMPILED ACROSS 30 NWN MODULES  93% CARRY THEIR OWN SOURCE. EVERY KOTOR MODULE SCRIPT IS COMPILED-ONLY WHILE BIOWARE KEPT SOURCE FOR THEIR OWN, APPLIED PRECISELY WHERE REOPENING MATTERS MOST. That is why twenty years of KOTOR modding has been DECOMPILATION and NWNs has been EDITING. Cost is roughly 2x on the script layer, A ROUNDING ERROR AGAINST AN 866 MB MODELS ARCHIVE.

LOADING FAILS LOUDLY AT EVERY STEP, on F35: KOTORS ENGINE WROTE AN INDEX PAST THE END OF THE TABLE IT INDEXES AND NOTHING REJECTED THE WRITE.

⚠ AND WHAT A PACKAGE DOES NOT CONTAIN IS AS LOAD-BEARING AS WHAT IT DOES. NO RUNTIME STATE  TRACE-85 found KOTORs save carrying A REPLACEMENT COPY OF EVERY VISITED MODULE, 112 fields inline per creature; ours does not, because PLAY-STATE-01 makes state a projection of an event log. A PACKAGE IS AUTHORED CONTENT; A SAVE IS A LOG; THEY NEVER LIVE IN THE SAME FOLDER. No compiled-only content. NO GLOBAL ANYTHING, since the game-wide journal and the global rules namespace ARE THE SAME MISTAKE TWICE. And no per-file export metadata.

FIVE OPEN ITEMS NAMED HONESTLY, including ⚠ HOW A CHAIN IS READ  [continues] names it and QUEST-MODEL-01 5 says conclusions cross, but THE MECHANISM IS NOT SPECIFIED.

## PT-1287 — EVENT-KINDS-01 written. ⚠ ONE VOCABULARY, TWO CONSUMERS  and a heartbeat is a missing kind wearing a costume

Closes AGENDA-RECORD-01 item 3, the last of the three that were called blocking. PLAY-STATE-01 2 gave four lifetimes and no vocabulary; ATTACHMENT-01 3 gave reactions a shape and no list.

⚠ THE STRUCTURAL DECISION: AN EVENT IS WHAT THE LOG RECORDS AND WHAT A REACTION LISTENS FOR, AND THEY ARE THE SAME LIST. Not two lists that agree  ONE LIST. PT-1268s reasoning applies directly: TWO LISTS THAT MEAN THE SAME THING DRIFT, AND THE DRIFT IS INVISIBLE UNTIL SOMETHING FAILS TO FIRE.

⚠⚠ AND TRACE-87s TWO CONFESSION HOOKS GAVE THE DESIGN TEST. KOTOR carries UserDefined, AN INTEGER-CODED EVENT SCRIPTS RAISE ON EACH OTHER AND THE ONLY OPEN EXTENSION POINT IN THE GAME, UNTYPED. And HEARTBEAT, WHICH IS A POLL BECAUSE THERE IS NO EVENT FOR WHAT THE AUTHOR NEEDED. EVERY USE OF A HEARTBEAT IS A QUESTION THE VOCABULARY COULD NOT ANSWER. So the test for this document is stated in it: IF AN AUTHOR WOULD REACH FOR A HEARTBEAT, A KIND IS MISSING  and both hooks are excluded.

⚠ PAST TENSE IS A RULE, NOT A STYLE. TRACE-85 found KOTORs combat API entirely past-tense, GetLastAttackResult, SO YOU OBSERVE RESOLUTION AND CANNOT REPLACE IT. For KOTOR that is a limitation; FOR US IT IS CORRECT. An event is A RECORD OF WHAT HAPPENED, NEVER A REQUEST FOR SOMETHING TO HAPPEN  and A REACTION THAT COULD PREVENT AN EVENT WOULD MAKE THE LOG A NEGOTIATION.

ROUGHLY THIRTY KINDS IN SIX GROUPS, each declaring its lifetime per PLAY-STATE-01. Three carry rulings forward rather than restating them: character.alignment-shifted is PERMANENT because PT-1279 established alignment history is not compactable; quest.flag-set is PERMANENT because PT-1284 ruled flags are never unset; and ⚠ note.written IS CAMPAIGN AND UNREADABLE  PT-1253 made Personal Notes private, so THE EVENT RECORDS THAT A NOTE EXISTS, NEVER ITS CONTENT.

⚠ AND item.* EVENTS EXIST EVEN THOUGH KOTOR GAVE ITEMS ZERO HOOKS  three of nine blueprint types are completely inert there. AN ITEM THAT CANNOT REACT IS AN ITEM THAT CANNOT BE A TRAP, A CURSED BLADE, OR A THING THAT REACTS TO BEING DRAWN.

check.resolved CARRIES ITS WHOLE DERIVATION, which is PLAY-STATE-01 5 made concrete: KOTOR persisted Defense Breakdown: 18 = base 10 + dex mod 4 + class 4, EVERY MODIFIER NAMED. That is what makes a derived system honest.

FOUR THINGS DELIBERATELY ABSENT AND EACH WITH ITS REASON: no heartbeat or timer; NO USER-DEFINED, because AN ESCAPE HATCH THAT ACCEPTS ANYTHING IS A VOCABULARY THAT HAS GIVEN UP; no pre-resolution events; and no perception, AI state or animation, already excluded as continuous-time machinery.

⚠ PAYLOAD SHAPES ARE LEFT UNSPECIFIED DELIBERATELY, and the document says why: PAYLOADS FOLLOW FROM THE SYSTEMS THAT EMIT THEM, AND INVENTING THEM HERE WOULD PRODUCE A PARALLEL DEFINITION  the exact failure this document was written to avoid. And filtering is open with TRACE-87 named as the guide: K1 NEEDED 2,345 BESPOKE GATE SCRIPTS AND K2 NEEDED 509 BECAUSE THE OPERAND MOVED INTO THE CONTENT FILE AND THE OPERATOR STAYED IN CODE.

## PT-1288 — ⚠ EVENT KINDS ARE TENSELESS, NOT PAST TENSE. A correction from B-theory, and the model was already B-theoretic

Owner raised whether B-theory of time  all times exist equally, and A-series language is rewritable in tenseless terms  might help with how events and records are established. It is relevant, and it caught a real imprecision I introduced hours earlier.

⚠ THE LOG IS ALREADY A B-SERIES AND NOBODY HAD SAID SO. Events sit at fixed positions. EVENT 47 DOES NOT BECOME MORE PAST AS THE CAMPAIGN RUNS. There is no privileged now in the log  NOW IS REPLAY TO THE END AND THEN IS REPLAY TO INDEX 47, and both are equally available. That is the B-theoretic claim, and it is why PT-1272s projection model works at all.

⚠ AND IT CORRECTS EVENT-KINDS-01, WHICH I WROTE TODAY. I stated PAST TENSE IS A RULE, NOT A STYLE. That is imprecise. character.damaged DOES NOT MEAN THE CHARACTER WAS DAMAGED  IT MEANS DAMAGE OCCURS AT INDEX 47. PAST TENSE SMUGGLES IN A MOVING NOW THAT THE LOG DOES NOT HAVE.

WHAT THE RULE IS ACTUALLY ABOUT IS DIRECTION OF FIT: AN EVENT RECORDS, IT DOES NOT REQUEST. I used tense as a proxy for that and picked the wrong word. TRACE-85s finding still supports it  KOTORs combat API is entirely observational, GetLastAttackResult, SO YOU SEE RESOLUTION AND CANNOT REPLACE IT  but observational is not the same claim as past tense.

⚠ AND IT SHARPENS COMPACTION. PT-1272 says a compacted log reaches the same end state by a shorter path and cannot replay to a point before its checkpoint. B-theoretically that is crisper: COMPACTION DESTROYS PART OF THE SERIES  CERTAIN EARLIER-THAN RELATIONS STOP EXISTING. That says WHAT IS GONE rather than WHAT YOU CANNOT DO, and it is the better statement of a real cost.

AND IT EXPLAINS WHY PT-1276s CROSS-CAMPAIGN DECISIONS CAME OUT SO CLEAN. In A-theoretic framing a sequel asks what happened IN THE PAST, which sounds like it needs machinery for PASTNESS. B-theoretically it is A QUERY AGAINST A DIFFERENT REGION OF THE SERIES, using the same mechanism  which is why those four decisions never needed a notion of the past at all, only NAMED POSITIONS.

⚠ WHERE IT DOES NOT APPLY, AND THIS IS THE USEFUL BOUNDARY: THE PLAYERS EXPERIENCE IS IRREDUCIBLY A-THEORETIC. They are IN a now, things are ABOUT TO HAPPEN, and PLAY-STATE-01 5s show-the-working  Defense Breakdown: 18 = base 10 + dex mod 4 + class 4  IS A PRESENT-TENSE STATEMENT TO A PERSON IN A MOMENT. SO THE MODEL IS B AND THE PRESENTATION IS A, which is the same split we already have between the log and its projections. The architecture was right for reasons that had not been articulated.

⚠ AND ONE THING DELIBERATELY NOT CHANGED: THE LIFETIME NAMES. permanent, campaign, session and transient SOUND A-THEORETIC AND ARE NOT ABOUT TEMPORAL BECOMING AT ALL  they are about SCOPE OF RELEVANCE FOR COMPACTION. Renaming them in tenseless language would cost clarity and buy nothing.

## PT-1289 — BUILDER-CONTRACT-01 written. ⚠ TIER 1 IS COMPLETE, and BUILDER-VISION-01 2 supplied the case that makes the contract concrete

Last Tier 1 document. PACKAGE-FORMAT-01 5 stated the thesis; this says WHAT SPECIFICALLY and WHY EACH PIECE IS NOT OPTIONAL.

⚠⚠ AND THE PROJECTS OWN BUILDER VISION SUPPLIED THE PERFECT CASE, WHICH IS BETTER THAN ANY INVENTED EXAMPLE. BUILDER-VISION-01 2 says of palette and freeform modes: BOTH MODES WRITE INTO THE SAME UNDERLYING AREA FORMAT. THE GAME ITSELF DOES NOT KNOW OR CARE WHICH MODE BUILT A GIVEN ROOM.

THAT IS CORRECT FOR THE APP AND FATAL FOR THE BUILDER. A ROOM BUILT IN PALETTE MODE AND REOPENED WITHOUT KNOWING THAT HAS BECOME A FREEFORM ROOM  the authors constraints are gone, the palette is unloaded, and THE NEXT EDIT IS A DIFFERENT KIND OF ACT THAN THE LAST ONE. So build_mode is written and THE APP IGNORES IT. That is the whole pattern in one field, drawn from our own documents rather than from KOTOR.

THE TEST IS STATED SO IT GENERALISES: FOR EVERY AUTHORING ACT, ASK WHETHER THE BUILDER CAN RECONSTRUCT WHAT THE AUTHOR DID AFTER IT IS WRITTEN. IF NOT, SOMETHING MUST BE WRITTEN THAT THE APP WILL NEVER READ.

WHAT IS WRITTEN: SOURCE ALWAYS, with compiled forms as a regenerable build artifact and ⚠ SOURCE AUTHORITATIVE ON MISMATCH. Authoring intent  build_mode, comments, palette state per PT-1105s art-pack lock, GROUPING per PT-1284 since grouping is a Builder view and NOTHING ELSE RECORDS IT, and display order where it is a view. Provenance  created_with, because A PACKAGE OUTLIVING ITS TOOL IS NORMAL, and path per PACKAGE-NAMING-01.

⚠ WHAT IS NOT WRITTEN, WITH A TEST RATHER THAN A LIST: WOULD A SECOND AUTHOR OPENING THIS PACKAGE WANT IT? Grouping yes; scroll position no. So no editor window state, no undo history, and NO CACHED DERIVATIONS  TRACE-85 found KOTOR freezing CombatInfo onto every creature, WHICH IS WHY ArcaneSpellFail, A D&D FIELD WITH NO KOTOR MEANING, SITS ON EVERY CREATURE IN THE GAME.

⚠⚠ THREE RULES KEEP IT HONEST AND THE THIRD IS THE CONTRACT ITSELF. THE APP MUST NEVER REQUIRE A BUILDER FIELD  the moment it reads build_mode to decide behaviour, the two are coupled and a hand-written package stops working. THE BUILDER MUST NEVER REQUIRE AN APP FIELD TO BE ABSENT  a badly hand-edited package should still open, with complaints. AND A BUILDER FIELD GOING MISSING DEGRADES AUTHORING, NEVER PLAY. Losing build_mode means reopening a room in the wrong mode; IT DOES NOT MEAN THE ROOM STOPS WORKING. THAT ASYMMETRY IS THE CONTRACT.

⚠ AND THE FAILURE IT PREVENTS IS NAMED FROM OUR OWN HISTORY: TRACE-86. Two study batches concluded KOTORs .mod files shipped when THE ENGINE WRITES THEM, because SHIPPED AND RUNTIME-WRITTEN FILES SAT IN ONE DIRECTORY AND THE FORMAT DID NOT DISTINGUISH THEM. So ANYTHING THE BUILDER WRITES IS AUTHORED  not a cache, not runtime state, not regenerable from play  AND IF A FIELD CANNOT SURVIVE THAT TEST IT DOES NOT GO IN THE PACKAGE.

TIER 1 OF AGENDA-DRAFTING-01 IS NOW COMPLETE: PACKAGE-NAMING-01, PACKAGE-FORMAT-01 and BUILDER-CONTRACT-01.

Tier 3 of AGENDA-DRAFTING-01, written BEFORE THE FIRST MODULE RATHER THAN AFTER THE TENTH, because a project that adds testing late TESTS WHAT IT HAPPENS TO HAVE BUILT RATHER THAN WHAT IT MEANT TO BUILD.

THREE LAYERS. ⚠ LAYER 1 IS THE SPEC CHECKS AND THEY ARE THE ONES NOBODY ELSE WOULD WRITE: every locked ruling with a mechanical consequence becomes a check testing NOT DOES THE CODE WORK BUT DOES THE CODE DO WHAT WE RULED.

⚠⚠ AND ALIGNMENT IS THE CASE FOR THE WHOLE LAYER. ALIGNMENT-01-v2 WARNS THAT A SYMMETRIC DEADBAND SILENTLY DISABLES MASTERY GAIN BY DRIFT AND PRODUCES ZERO BAND FLIPS IN TESTING, WHICH LOOKS LIKE SUCCESS. A conventional test suite PASSES. ONLY A CHECK WRITTEN AGAINST THE RULING CATCHES IT. That is a bug whose symptom is nothing happening, which is the silent-no-op family in a new place.

LAYER 2 IS THE INVARIANTS, and ⚠ PT-1272s REPLAY GUARANTEE IS THE LOAD-BEARING ONE: PT-1268s ENTIRE AI ARGUMENT RESTS ON IT, since AI downstream is safe BECAUSE replay is deterministic. IF THAT INVARIANT BREAKS, A RULING TWO STEPS AWAY SILENTLY BECOMES WRONG. Layer 3 is ordinary tests and is explicitly NOT where the value is.

SIX FAILURE FAMILIES ARE LISTED AS CHECKS WAITING TO BE WRITTEN, all named by the corpus already. ⚠ SILENT NO-OP GETS EMPHASIS: TRACE-86 RETRACTED TWO BATCHES CONCLUSIONS BECAUSE NOBODY CHECKED A TIMESTAMP, ONE COMMAND  and A TEST THAT ASSERTS A FUNCTION WAS CALLED RATHER THAN THAT IT DID SOMETHING IS THE SAME FAILURE IN CODE.

FOUR RULES. ⚠ A CHECK IS WRITTEN WHEN THE RULING IS MADE, NOT LATER, because THE WINDOW WHERE YOU KNOW EXACTLY WHAT WENT WRONG IS SHORT. A FAILING CHECK NAMES ITS RULING  expected true got false is useless where PT-1227 the plus must disappear at the cap, it rendered at 18 teaches the reader something. ⚠ A CHECK THAT HAS NEVER FAILED IS UNPROVEN, and the precedent is concrete: check_absence_claims.py was tested with THREE PROBES, TWO THAT MUST FIRE AND ONE THAT MUST NOT.

⚠ AND NO COVERAGE TARGETS. COVERAGE MEASURES WHAT RAN, NOT WHAT WAS CHECKED. The metric is HOW MANY LOCKED RULINGS HAVE A SPEC CHECK, which is countable and meaningful where a percentage is not.

⚠ ONE OPEN ITEM WORTH FLAGGING: PERFORMANCE. The document gate is fast because documents are small. A REPLAY-DETERMINISM CHECK ON A LONG LOG IS NOT, and may need to run less often than every commit  which would be the first crack in the one-command discipline.

## TRACE-91 — Extraction pilot: skills. Count verified at 24, and ⚠ NINETEEN OF OUR TWENTY-FOUR SKILLS HAVE NO DESCRIPTION ANYWHERE

First data-extraction run, deliberately scoped to the cheapest piece before six thousand lines follow the same method. VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY IN THIS CONTAINER rather than accepted on report.

THE METHOD WORKS. data/extracted/skills.json holds EXACTLY 24 RECORDS with the specified shape  id, name, attribute, description, source  and every source carries a LINE NUMBER, not just a filename. The count check passed on the first run.

⚠ AND THE TRAP DID NOT FIRE THIS TIME. The agent had previously read SKILLS-01 line 15 and reported it as saying twenty-two skills, which is THE QUOTED TEXT OF A HISTORICAL ERROR that PT-865 corrected. Warned in the prompt, it read for what the document ASSERTS rather than what it QUOTES. A corpus that records its corrections in place will keep producing this, and naming the specific trap in the prompt is what prevented it.

⚠⚠ THE FINDING THE COUNT CHECK COULD NOT HAVE CAUGHT: NINETEEN OF TWENTY-FOUR RECORDS HAVE AN EMPTY DESCRIPTION. Only five carry prose  ARCHAEOLOGY, BOTANY, MYSTICISM, SCIENCE AND XENOLOGY, all knowledge skills with numbered sections in SKILLS-01. The other nineteen  including Stealth, Persuade, Demolitions, Awareness and Security  EXIST ONLY AS A ROW IN THE MASTER TABLE.

VERIFIED RATHER THAN ASSUMED: SKILLS-01 line 96 reads Stealth  Hide + Move Silently, rolled together in practice. THAT IS A DERIVATION NOTE, NOT A DESCRIPTION. It says what Stealth WAS MERGED FROM; it never says WHAT STEALTH DOES. Stealth appears in 34 rules documents, Persuade in 26, Demolitions in 21  they are heavily USED and nowhere DEFINED.

⚠ AND THIS IS A CONTENT GAP THAT BLOCKS ALREADY-LOCKED UI. PT-1201 and PT-1230 both lock a skills screen with A DESCRIPTION PANEL, and PT-1250 locks the in-game Abilities tab with another. NINETEEN OF TWENTY-FOUR SKILLS HAVE NOTHING TO PUT IN THEM. The mockups filled that panel with prose this agent wrote as placeholder text, which was never flagged as invented because it read as plausible.

⚠ THE INSTRUCTION THAT MADE THIS VISIBLE WORKED EXACTLY AS INTENDED: IF A VALUE IS UNCLEAR, LEAVE IT NULL AND SAY SO, because A GUESSED VALUE IN STRUCTURED DATA IS INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM A REAL ONE. Nineteen empty fields are a legible gap. Nineteen plausible sentences would have been an invisible one, and would have been extracted, committed and trusted.

AND A PROCESS NOTE: the agent PUSHED TO HANDOFF rather than reporting inline, having write access there but not to MAIN_WORK. Correct behaviour under the prompts fallback, and worth recording because the output was not where the reporting channel implied it would be.

NEXT: the record shape is proven and the remaining eight documents can follow it. ⚠ BUT THE NINETEEN MISSING DESCRIPTIONS ARE AUTHORING WORK, NOT EXTRACTION WORK, and no amount of extraction will produce them.

## PT-1291 — Nineteen missing skill descriptions written. ⚠ THEY WERE NOT MISSING, THEY WERE SCATTERED  and checking first meant assembling rather than inventing

TRACE-91s pilot found nineteen of twenty-four skills carrying no description, blocking three locked screens. Owner asked to check whether the descriptions existed elsewhere before writing anything.

⚠ THEY LARGELY DID, AND THAT CHANGED THE WORK ENTIRELY. SKILL-RESOLUTION-01 specifies HOW EACH SKILL BEHAVES in real detail  five resolution modes, six resource skills with their named consumables, two effect-mode skills, Stealth with its own section, social skills opposed and resisting differently. And SKILLS-01s own master table carries A DERIVATION COLUMN for most skills: Stealth is Hide plus Move Silently, Security is Disable Device plus Open Lock, Streetwise is Gather Information plus Disguise plus the SOURCING half of Forgery.

SO THE DESCRIPTIONS WERE NEVER MISSING  THEY WERE SCATTERED ACROSS TWO DOCUMENTS AND A TABLE COLUMN, and what was absent was ONE LINE PER SKILL SAYING WHAT THE THING IS. That is assembly work, not authoring work, and it is a far safer operation.

⚠ AND THIS IS THE FOURTH TIME TODAY THAT CHECKING BEFORE WRITING CHANGED THE JOB. Cluster B found BEASTS-ENTRIES-01 already had an authored-creature model. Cluster C found GROUND-AI-01 already had combat doctrine, unbound. Cluster D found ITEMS-08 already had the slot rulings. And PT-1278 found FACTIONS-01 sitting unread after faction had been deferred twice. THE PATTERN IS CONSISTENT ENOUGH TO BE A RULE RATHER THAN A HABIT.

WRITTEN AS A NEW SECTION OF SKILLS-01, twenty-four rows, EVERY LINE TRACEABLE to the derivation column or to a SKILL-RESOLUTION-01 rule. ⚠ AND WHERE THE CORPUS SAID NOTHING, THE LINE SAYS LESS RATHER THAN INVENTING MORE  Appraise, Sleight of Hand and Pilot get plain one-line statements because plain is what the corpus supports.

⚠ TWO THINGS THE SECTION DELIBERATELY DOES NOT DO. It does NOT restate the resolution mode, because that is SKILL-RESOLUTION-01s job and DUPLICATING IT WOULD CREATE TWO SOURCES THAT DRIFT  the exact failure PT-1287 avoided by keeping one event vocabulary. And it does NOT assign aptitude, which SKILLS-01 11 governs.

⚠ AND THE ORIGINAL PROBLEM IS WORTH RESTATING BECAUSE IT NEARLY PASSED UNSEEN: the UI mockups filled those description panels with prose THIS AGENT WROTE AS PLACEHOLDER, and it was never flagged as invented BECAUSE IT READ AS PLAUSIBLE. The extraction only surfaced it because the instruction was LEAVE IT NULL AND SAY SO. Nineteen empty fields are a legible gap; nineteen plausible sentences are an invisible one.

AGENDA-RECORD-01 item 3a closes. ⚠ AND THE EXTRACTION SHOULD BE RE-RUN  skills.json currently carries nineteen empty description fields against a document that now has them.

## PT-1296 — ⚠ I WAS WRONG ABOUT SURVIVAL, and K2 ANSWERS THE PRESTIGE QUESTION: every prestige class DECLARES a list, and each is a COPY of its base

Owner asked me to re-check the Survival claim. I was wrong, and the error was the same shape as the other five today.

⚠⚠ SURVIVAL IS GRANTED BY FOUR SPECIES. SPECIES-CHAPTER-v2 carries +2 Survival on four entries, including Zabrak Clanhold. My earlier grep searched SPECIES-SKILLS-TABLE AND SPECIES-DROIDS-AND-NEW ONLY, found nothing, AND I CONCLUDED THE SKILL WAS GRANTED BY NO SPECIES  without searching THE DOCUMENT THAT ACTUALLY DEFINES SPECIES. Sixth wrong-place error, and the most consequential, because I then FLAGGED TWO DOCUMENTS AS ASSERTING SOMETHING FALSE WHEN THEY WERE TRUE.

⚠ AND I EDITED A FILE MARKED DO NOT EDIT. SPECIES-SKILLS-TABLEs header reads DERIVED from SPECIES-CHAPTER-v2. REGENERATE; DO NOT EDIT. I wrote a flag into it anyway. Both flags reverted; both claims restored and renumbered to twenty-five, which was ALL THEY EVER NEEDED.

⚠ BUT THE CHECK FOUND A REAL FINDING UNDERNEATH: THE DERIVED TABLE IS STALE. Source grants Survival to FOUR species; the derived table contains ZERO. And that file already warns THIS FILE WAS STALE FOR THREE ROWS AND THE LIBRARY CAUGHT IT BY CONTENT-READ. It is stale again, the same way. A DERIVED FILE BEHIND ITS SOURCE IS NOT A RULE CONFLICT  IT IS A REGENERATION THAT DID NOT HAPPEN, in the files own words. IT NEEDS REGENERATING.

⚠⚠ AND K2 ANSWERS THE PRESTIGE QUESTION DIRECTLY. k2_skills.2da carries FIFTEEN PER-CLASS COLUMNS, and EVERY PRESTIGE CLASS HAS ITS OWN  jwm for Weaponmaster, jwa for Watchman, jma for Master, sma for Marauder, sld for Sith Lord, sas for Assassin.

⚠ AND EACH PRESTIGE LIST IS A COPY OF ITS BASE CLASS. Weaponmaster is Demolitions, Awareness, Persuade, TreatInjury  IDENTICAL to Guardian. Watchman is identical to Sentinel. Jedi Master and Sith Lord are both identical to Consular. Sith Marauder is identical to Guardian and Weaponmaster.

SO K2s ANSWER IS: DECLARE EXPLICITLY, INHERIT IN PRACTICE. The structure supports a distinct list per prestige class; THE DATA NEVER USES THAT FREEDOM. That is the strongest available argument that inheritance is the right DEFAULT and a distinct list should be possible but rare.

AND IT SUPPORTS THE OWNERS STATED RULE  A CHARACTER WITH TWO CLASSES HAS THE COMBINED CLASS SKILLS OF BOTH. Under K2s pattern a Guardian/Weaponmaster union IS the Guardian list, so the rule costs nothing in the common case and does the right thing where a prestige class genuinely diverges.

⚠ ONE CAUTION FOR OUR VERSION: K2 HAS EIGHT SKILLS AND ITS LISTS RUN THREE TO SIX. Ours has twenty-five and SKILLS-01 9.2s lists run FIVE TO ELEVEN. A UNION OF TWO ELEVEN-SKILL LISTS COULD REACH MOST OF THE SYSTEM, which K2s eight-skill pool made impossible. The rule is right; ITS CONSEQUENCES ARE LARGER AT OUR SCALE and should be checked against real pairs before locking.

## PT-1297 — Union rule CONFIRMED for multiclass skills. The per-level-up alternative was raised, considered and declined

Owner raised a per-level-up cost rule: when you level a specific class, only THAT classs aptitudes are cheap, so Persuade might cost one point on a Scout level and two on a Soldier level. Then, asked to choose, ruled for THE UNION.

⚠ AND THE UNION IS ALREADY RULED  MULTICLASS-01 LINE 103: EVERY CLASS YOU HOLD CONTRIBUTES ITS CLASS SKILL LIST. ALL OF THEM ARE CLASS SKILLS. So NOTHING CHANGES. This ruling records that the alternative was raised and declined, so it is not re-opened later as an unconsidered option.

WHAT THE UNION MEANS IN PRACTICE: hold Scout and Soldier, and a skill on EITHER list is a class skill for you PERMANENTLY, at every level-up, regardless of which class you take that level in.

WHAT THE DECLINED ALTERNATIVE WOULD HAVE MEANT: the same skill costing one point or two DEPENDING ON WHICH CLASS YOU LEVELLED THAT TURN  which is trackable but means A PLAYER MUST KNOW WHICH CLASS THEY ARE LEVELLING BEFORE THEY CAN READ A COST, and the skills screen would need to show costs that CHANGE BETWEEN LEVEL-UPS.

⚠ AND THE CAUTION FROM PT-1296 STANDS AND IS NOW LOAD-BEARING: K2 HAS EIGHT SKILLS WITH CLASS LISTS OF THREE TO SIX. OURS HAS TWENTY-FIVE WITH LISTS OF FIVE TO ELEVEN. A UNION OF TWO ELEVEN-SKILL LISTS COULD REACH TWENTY-TWO OF TWENTY-FIVE  something K2s small pool made structurally impossible. The union is right and IT IS MUCH MORE GENEROUS AT OUR SCALE THAN AT KOTORS. That is a balance question for playtest rather than a reason to change the rule, and it should be checked against REAL CLASS PAIRS rather than assumed benign.

Consistent with PT-1296s finding that K2 gives every prestige class its own column and FILLS EACH WITH A COPY OF ITS BASE  declare explicitly, inherit in practice.

## PT-1298 — check_derived.py. ⚠ A STALE DERIVED FILE IS INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM A CORRECT ONE, and it caught Survival on its first run

Owner approved plugs 1 and 2 together after a session where ONE STALE DERIVED FILE PRODUCED THREE DOWNSTREAM ERRORS.

⚠ THE DIAGNOSIS, MEASURED RATHER THAN ASSERTED: 151 documents in the corpus, 27 mentioning derivation, AND THREE SYNC CHECKS AMONG 42 AUDITS  audit_beasts, audit_featsync and audit_sheets. The pattern was proven and simply had not been applied to derived DOCUMENTS.

⚠⚠ THE CONSEQUENCE THAT MATTERS: A STALE DERIVED FILE IS WELL-FORMED, INTERNALLY CONSISTENT AND CONFIDENTLY WRONG. The only way to detect it is to open its source  WHICH IS EXACTLY WHAT NOBODY DOES, BECAUSE THE DERIVED FILE EXISTS SO YOU DO NOT HAVE TO. And the damage propagates: reading SPECIES-SKILLS-TABLE instead of SPECIES-CHAPTER-v2 led me to FLAG TWO CORRECT DOCUMENTS AS FALSE, EDIT A FILE MARKED DO-NOT-EDIT, AND PUT A FABRICATED QUESTION TO THE OWNER. ⚠ THE COST OF STALENESS IS NOT THE WRONG FILE  IT IS THE DECISIONS TAKEN ABOUT THE WRONG FILE.

⚠ PLUG 2 TURNED OUT TO BE NECESSARY RATHER THAN CONVENIENT. Surveying the corpus for derived from as PROSE returned matches like derived from state rather than authored and DERIVED FROM THEIR OWN LEVEL-20 SAVES  PROSE IS NOT PARSEABLE AND ONLY ONE FILE IN 151 GENUINELY DECLARES A DOCUMENT SOURCE IN ITS HEADER. So the check reads A MACHINE-READABLE MARKER, derived-from in an HTML comment, and SPECIES-SKILLS-TABLE now carries one.

IT CAUGHT Survival ON ITS FIRST RUN  the exact failure, before any human read the file.

⚠ AND ONE FALSE-POSITIVE PASS WAS NEEDED, WHICH IS THE DISCIPLINE PT-1280 ESTABLISHED. The first version flagged EIGHT terms, seven of them ABILITY SCORES  Constitution, Dexterity and friends  because +2 Survival and +2 Constitution are the same pattern. A SKILLS TABLE CORRECTLY OMITS ABILITY ADJUSTMENTS. Tightened to intersect against SKILLS-01s master table, so only REAL SKILLS count. One finding remains and it is the true one.

⚠ FILED AS REPORTING, NOT BLOCKING, and the corpus supplied the reasoning in its own words: A DERIVED FILE BEHIND ITS SOURCE IS NOT A RULE CONFLICT. IT IS A REGENERATION THAT DID NOT HAPPEN.

⚠ AND THE HONEST LIMIT: IT CANNOT PROVE A DERIVATION IS CORRECT, ONLY THAT ONE IS INCOMPLETE. That is the failure that actually happens, and claiming more would be the false confidence PT-1262 rejected when it declined a ruling-log harvester.

Gate now runs 46 checks.

## PT-1303 — ⚠ TYPED TEXT THAT MEANS AN AUTHORED REPLY COUNTS AS PICKING IT. The one gap 4.3 left open

Owner asked what the open question meant plainly, then agreed the ruling.

⚠ CHECKING FIRST CORRECTED MY OWN FRAMING, AND THIS IS THE FIFTH TIME TODAY THE CORPUS ALREADY HELD THE ANSWER. I had been describing free-typed dialogue as a new problem. ENGINE-SPEC-03 4.3 ALREADY RULES IT: THE PLAYER TYPES SOMETHING THE TREE DOES NOT OFFER, THE AI ANSWERS IN CHARACTER, THEN THE SAME OPTIONS ARE SHOWN AGAIN. Nothing written to the ledger, no condition changed. THE AI NEVER ADVANCES THE PLOT.

AND 4.2 HOLDS THE MECHANISM I WAS REACHING FOR: the AI REWRITES THE SURFACE OF A LINE WHOSE CONTENT IS ALREADY FIXED. The Shadowlands are dangerous, few return becomes youre bleeding, and you want to go down there. SAME MEANING, SAME CONDITION, SAME NEXT NODE, ONLY THE WORDS DIFFER.

⚠ THE ONE GENUINE GAP: 4.3 covers text that reaches NOTHING. IT DOES NOT SAY WHAT HAPPENS WHEN TYPED TEXT MEANS AN AUTHORED OPTION. Gadons tree carries you need us more than we need you; the player types seems to me youre the one who needs this.

RULED: THAT COUNTS AS PICKING THE AUTHORED REPLY. The branch fires, the check runs, the tree advances, THE PLAYERS WORDS ARE SHOWN AND THE AUTHORS BRANCH IS WHAT HAPPENED.

⚠ WHY ANSWER-AND-RETURN WOULD BE WRONG HERE, and it is the strongest argument available: IT PRODUCES THE WORST MOMENT IN THE DESIGN  YOU SAY THE RIGHT THING AND THE GAME DOES NOT HEAR YOU, then shows you a menu CONTAINING YOUR OWN SENTENCE and asks you to click it. THAT IS NOT FREEDOM, IT IS A TYPING EXERCISE BEFORE THE REAL CHOICE. 4.3 stays correct for text reaching nothing; THE DISTINCTION IS WHETHER AN AUTHORED BRANCH EXISTS, NOT WHETHER THE PLAYER TYPED.

⚠ AND IT IS 4.2s MECHANISM MIRRORED RATHER THAN A NEW POWER. There the AI recognises an authored NPC line and rephrases it; here it recognises a player line as an authored reply. ONE RULE, TWO DIRECTIONS.

4.3s GUARANTEE SURVIVES INTACT AND THAT IS THE TEST THIS RULING HAD TO PASS. THE AI STILL NEVER ADVANCES THE PLOT  THE AUTHOR WROTE THAT BRANCH, and the AI decided WHICH OF THE AUTHORS DOORS THE PLAYER WAS KNOCKING ON, which is THE JOB A MENU DOES. An AI CHOOSING the next node makes a story decision; an AI RECOGNISING WHICH AUTHORED OPTION YOU MEANT does not.

⚠ THE COST IS STATED RATHER THAN HIDDEN: THE AI CAN MISRECOGNISE and fire a branch the player did not mean. A MENU NEVER HAS THIS RISK. So A TYPED LINE THAT FIRES AN AUTHORED BRANCH MUST BE VISIBLE AS IT FIRES  the option surfacing, or the check appearing. NOT A CONFIRMATION DIALOGUE; NOT SILENCE EITHER. A PLAYER MUST NEVER LEARN FROM CONSEQUENCES THAT THE PLOT MOVED ON A MISREADING.

The signalling mechanism is NOT specified and is open work, already asked of the dialogue study.

## PT-1304 — Dialogue recognition added to TESTING-01 as its own layer. ⚠ AND THE STRONGEST CASE IS DETERMINISTIC DESPITE TESTING A NON-DETERMINISTIC COMPONENT

Owner ruled that PT-1303s cases go into testing. Written as TESTING-01 layer 1a, because it does not fit the existing three.

⚠ WHY IT NEEDS ITS OWN LAYER: PT-1303 LETS THE AI FIRE AN AUTHORED BRANCH FROM TYPED TEXT, AND THAT IS THE ONLY PLACE IN THIS DESIGN WHERE A NON-DETERMINISTIC COMPONENT REACHES A DETERMINISTIC ONE. Everywhere else PT-1268 holds AI strictly downstream.

⚠ AND ORDINARY TESTS CANNOT COVER IT. A test asserting THIS SENTENCE MAPS TO OPTION 3 WILL FLAKE, because the component under test is a model. So the cases ASSERT PROPERTIES, NOT OUTPUTS: off-script text writes NOTHING to the ledger; off-script text leaves the option set unchanged; a fired branch is one THE AUTHOR WROTE; a fired branch is VISIBLE as it fires; and THE CHECK STILL RUNS, so typing past a Persuade 14 gate cannot bypass it.

⚠⚠ AND THE CHEAPEST CASE IS THE STRONGEST, AND IT IS DETERMINISTIC: RUN A CONVERSATION WITH AI OFF AND RECORD THE BRANCH SEQUENCE. RUN THE SAME PICKS WITH AI ON. THE SEQUENCES MUST BE IDENTICAL. That single case PROVES THE AI IS A SURFACE LAYER AND NOT A DECISION LAYER, and it tests a non-deterministic component without ever asserting what the model said. It is 4.2s own promise turned into a check: NOTHING IS LOST, NOTHING IS GATED BEHIND AI.

⚠ THE FAILURE THE LAYER EXISTS TO CATCH IS NAMED PLAINLY: A MISRECOGNITION THAT FIRES THE WRONG BRANCH AND LOOKS LIKE THE PLAYERS OWN CHOICE. The player types, the plot moves, AND NOBODY CAN TELL AFTERWARDS WHETHER THE AI MISREAD THEM OR THEY CHOSE BADLY.

SO EVERY AI-FIRED BRANCH RECORDS WHAT WAS TYPED ALONGSIDE THE OPTION ID, per PT-1266s rule that typed text is stored and never branched on. THE LOG MUST BE ABLE TO ANSWER DID THE AI GET THIS RIGHT MONTHS LATER. ⚠ WITHOUT THAT FIELD THE QUESTION IS UNANSWERABLE, WHICH IS WORSE THAN A WRONG ANSWER  and it is the same reasoning as PT-1291s nineteen null descriptions: A LEGIBLE GAP BEATS AN INVISIBLE ONE.

## TRACE-93 — Dialogue options study. ⚠⚠ KOTORS BRACKET LIES  62% OF BRACKETED REPLIES HAVE NO GATE  and K2 marks a committing reply WITH A SOUND, which is the one mechanism a typed line can use

Every DLG in both games with every player reply resolved through the TLK, plus Daggerfalls shipped data and the reimplementations TalkManager. Neither game run.

⚠⚠ THE BRACKET IS AUTHORED TEXT AND IT DOES NOT TRACK THE MECHANIC. No field produces it  every reply field searched in both games, and no prefix, tag, marker, skill-id or gate-label field exists. [Persuade] IS LITERAL TEXT AT THE START OF THE TLK ENTRY.

    gated AND bracketed        K1   425    K2   571
    bracketed but NOT gated    K1   708    K2   462
    gated but NOT bracketed    K1 1,528    K2 2,249

62% OF K1s BRACKETED REPLIES HAVE NO GATE AT ALL, and 1,528 GATED REPLIES CARRY NO BRACKET. THE PLAYER LEARNS A VISUAL TELL THAT IS WRONG MORE OFTEN THAN RIGHT. 119 distinct prefixes in K1 and 93 in K2, NINETY OF K1s USED EXACTLY ONCE  and THREE DIFFERENT THINGS SHARE ONE CHANNEL: skill gates, stage directions like [Leave.], and outright notifications like [T3-M4 has joined your party.].

⚠ AND A CORRECTION TO A COMMON ASSUMPTION: [Success] AND [Failure] ARE NOT A REPLY CONVENTION. 1,264 occurrences in K1s string table and 831 in K2s, AND ZERO AS A REPLY PREFIX  they belong to the computer terminal channel. SKILL-CHECK OUTCOME NEVER REACHES THE PLAYERS OPTION.

NO ORDERING FIELD EXISTS. Only Index and PlotIndex; K2 adds eighteen gate fields and NO position, priority or sort. Order is THE ARRAY ORDER THE WRITER TYPED. ⚠ And over half of K1s ReplyList  16,179 OF 27,465  HAVE NO TEXT AT ALL. They are SILENT ROUTING NODES; the reply list is mostly plumbing.

⚠ DAGGERFALL ASSEMBLES TOPICS FROM WORLD STATE  no tree AND no authored topic list. Four lists built at runtime. ⚠ AND THE FILTER IS TRI-STATE: NotSet, DoesNotKnowAboutItem, KnowsAboutItem. DOES NOT KNOW IS A DISTINCT STATE FROM NOT YET DETERMINED, WHICH IS PRECISELY THE MECHANISM KOTORS BRACKET SHOULD HAVE BEEN. Asking changes availability three ways. And one category, Where is > Things, HAS SHIPPED NON-FUNCTIONAL SINCE 1996 IN BOTH THE ORIGINAL AND THE FAITHFUL RE-CREATION.

ITS INTERFACE IS THE WARNING: TWENTY CHARACTERS PER LABEL, THIRTEEN ROWS, NO SEARCH, AND YOU NEVER SAY ANYTHING  selecting a topic is A DATABASE QUERY, NOT AN UTTERANCE.

⚠⚠ AND THE ARGUMENT FOR WHAT WE ARE BUILDING, IN THE AGENTS OWN WORDS: THE MOMENT A LIST IS THE ONLY WAY IN, IT MUST BE COMPLETE  AND A COMPLETE LIST IS UNUSABLE. TYPED INPUT IS WHAT MAKES AN INCOMPLETE PROMPT LIST LEGITIMATE.

⚠⚠ THE ADDENDUM ANSWERS THE QUESTION I THOUGHT HAD NO ANSWER. K2 PLAYS A STINGER WHEN A MORALLY-WEIGHTED REPLY COMMITS. guisounds.2da gains two rows over K1  DarkSide and LightSide  and the assets exist in K2s BIF and filesystem AND IN NEITHER PLACE IN K1. And alignment shifts fire OVERWHELMINGLY FROM THE PLAYERS OWN LINE: 275 of 365 in K1, 525 OF 631 IN K2, 83%.

⚠ NOTE WHERE THOSE ROWS LIVE: NOT in ambientmusic.2da with the other stingers, but IN guisounds.2da BESIDE Quest_New_Notify AND Level_Up_Notify. K2 CLASSIFIED AN ALIGNMENT SHIFT AS A UI NOTIFICATION, SAME CATEGORY AS GAINING A LEVEL.

⚠⚠ AND THE REASON IT TRANSFERS IS EXACT: IT IS TEMPORAL, NOT SPATIAL. A SOUND NEEDS NO ON-SCREEN OBJECT TO ATTACH TO. It marks THE MOMENT, which is precisely what a typed line has and a pre-rendered option does not. Everything else either game does needs A ROW TO HANG ON.

BOTH GAMES ALSO LOG THE PLAYERS LINE UNDER THEIR OWN NAME  PT_DLG_MSG_LIST carries Spkr and Msg, and the player character appears as a speaker beside Canderous and Malak. That converts A CHOSEN LINE INTO A THING THAT WAS SAID, and for typed text it is nearly free.

⚠ AND WHAT NEITHER GAME HAS: NOTHING MARKS A REPLY WITH THE OUTCOME OF ITS CHECK. No field, no sound, no colour, no transcript treatment saying that was a Persuade and it worked. THE BRACKET ANNOUNCES A SKILL BEFORE THE LINE, UNRELIABLY, AND THEN NOTHING FOLLOWS. THE CHECK RESOLVES SILENTLY. So the split is clean: BORROW the sound-at-commit and the transcript attribution; INVENT the check marker, where the space is genuinely empty  no precedent to borrow and no bad precedent to avoid.

## TRACE-94 — Movie playback runtime. ⚠ K2 MOVIES ARE A BEAT INSIDE A SCENE, NOT THE END OF ONE  and the agent discarded its own method after it produced 862 false hits

⚠⚠ THE METHOD FAILURE IS WORTH RECORDING FIRST BECAUSE THE AGENT CAUGHT AND DISCARDED IT ITSELF. It searched compiled NCS bytecode for movie filenames as string literals and got 862 CREATURE SPAWN CALL SITES IN K2. Nonsense  K2s movie files include credits, legal, aspyr and trailer, ORDINARY WORDS APPEARING IN UNRELATED BYTECODE. It verified on k_def_spawn01, which matched only on credits and whose shipped source CONTAINS NO MOVIE CALL AT ALL. The numbers were thrown away and everything reported came from shipped NSS source.

AND THE HONEST CONSEQUENCE IS STATED: module scripts are compiled-only, so EVERY COUNT IS A FLOOR, AND THE GAP IS VISIBLY LARGE  K1 SHIPS 61 MOVIE FILES AND ITS READABLE SOURCE NAMES ONLY 14.

THE CALL: PlayMovie(string), QueueMovie(string, int skippable), PlayMovieQueue(int). ⚠ NAMED BY A PLAIN STRING  not a ResRef, though GFF has that type, and not an index into movies.2da. That confirms batch 6s gallery finding FROM THE OTHER DIRECTION.

⚠ AND K2s IsMoviePlaying IS DOCUMENTED IN ITS OWN SOURCE AS A DUMMY FUNC SO WE CAN COMPILE. THE ONE FUNCTION THAT WOULD LET A SCRIPT WAIT FOR A MOVIE IS A STUB IN THE SEQUEL. That is the fifth dead capability the study has found.

⚠⚠ MOVIES ARE CALLED MID-CONVERSATION, AND IT IS THE K1/K2 DIFFERENCE. K1 has FIVE movie-calling dialogue nodes and ALL FIVE ARE TERMINAL  the movie ends the conversation. K2 has SEVEN terminal AND FOUR THAT CONTINUE: three speaker nodes and one player reply, all calling a_playpermov, which reads GetScriptParameter and switches to pick one of seven permov files. THAT IS BATCH 5s PARAMETERISED-PRIMITIVE PATTERN APPLIED TO MOVIE SELECTION. THE MOVIE IS A BEAT INSIDE THE SCENE, NOT THE END OF IT.

AND ⚠ Mod_StartMovie  the IFO field batch 4 found on ALL 239 MODULES  IS POPULATED ON ZERO OF THEM. Sixth dead capability. NO object, area or module hook is bound to any movie script in either game.

TRANSITION IS A HARD CUT: FadeType IS 0 ON ALL SIXTEEN MOVIE-CALLING NODES ACROSS BOTH GAMES, without exception, and no Delay either. The only fade near a movie is SetGlobalFadeOut inside k_sup_galaxymap  IN THE SCRIPT, NOT ON THE NODE.

⚠ AND THE CALLING PATTERN CHANGED AS MUCH AS THE BUDGET. K1: 63 PlayMovie, ZERO queue calls. K2: 10 PlayMovie, 26 QueueMovie, 7 PlayMovieQueue. K1 PLAYS ONE MOVIE AND FORGETS IT; K2 BUILDS SEQUENCES  QueueMovie, QueueMovie, PlayMovieQueue, StartNewModule. A JOURNEY COMPOSED FROM REUSABLE PIECES.

SO WHAT 1,600 MB ACROSS 67 FILES BUYS IS NOT LONGER MOVIES BUT MOVIES THAT COMBINE. And the migration is visible in the source: k_align_movie has A COMMENTED-OUT PlayMovie SITTING DIRECTLY ABOVE THE TWO QueueMovie CALLS THAT REPLACED IT.

ODDITY WORTH KEEPING: k_qa carries 43 PlayMovie and 50 DelayCommand calls  A QA HARNESS SHIPPED IN K1s BIF, and the largest concentration of movie calls in either game.

TWO THINGS NEED THE RUNNING GAME AND ARE SAID SO RATHER THAN GUESSED: whether the module unloads, and whether PlayMovie blocks its caller. The agent noted PlayMovie takes no action parameter and batch 5 established only three functions do, SO THERE IS NO MECHANISM BY WHICH IT COULD SUSPEND  but labelled that INFERENCE, NOT OBSERVATION.
