## TRACE-107 — Daggerfalls blocks. ⚠⚠ ROTATION IS TWO BITS, THERE IS NO EDGE-MATCHING, and THREE GAMES DISAGREE ABOUT DOORS BY A FACTOR OF SEVEN

Shipped data only. ⚠ NO REIMPLEMENTATION SOURCE READ  Daggerfall Unity is not on the machine and nothing was borrowed from it. Both archives parse SELF-VALIDATINGLY: walking record sizes from the header lands EXACTLY on the first byte of the directory in both files with no slack, and A WRONG STRIDE WOULD NOT DO THAT.

BLOCKS.BSA: 1,295 records, 920 RMB exterior and 187 RDB dungeon, VARIABLE SIZE with a fourteen-fold range. ⚠ AND ABOUT TWENTY OF THE 1,295 ARE SOMEBODYS WORKING FILES, SHIPPED: FOO, FOOBAR, SHIT, BRUCE, TEST, TEMP, BACKUP, AAANEW, ZZZZZZZ.

⚠⚠ THE STRONGEST FINDING AND THE ANSWER TO THE QUESTION ASKED: ROTATION IS TWO BITS. Every RMB carries a 32-entry table, and across ALL 920 FILES  29,440 ENTRIES  the second UInt16 takes FOUR VALUES AND NO OTHERS: 0x0000, 0x4000, 0x8000, 0xC000. A QUARTER-TURN FIELD. A CORRIDOR SECTION IS AUTHORED ONCE AND USED FOUR WAYS.

⚠ AND ITS ARGUMENT FOR WHY THAT MATTERS MORE FOR US IS THE BEST LINE IN THE STUDY: GENERATION CAN AFFORD A BIG LIBRARY BECAUSE NOBODY BROWSES IT. AN AUTHOR BROWSES. A PALETTE OF 900 CORRIDOR PIECES IS UNUSABLE; 225 WITH A ROTATE KEY IS A PALETTE.

⚠⚠ AND THERE IS NO EDGE-MATCHING ANYWHERE. It looked and found none, with the positive evidence pointing the other way: variation is BY BULK  S, M and L of the same function, confirmed by triples like TVRNAS, TVRNAM, TVRNAL  and function codes describe WHAT A BLOCK IS RATHER THAN HOW IT CONNECTS.

THE LIKELY MECHANISM IS CONVENTION RATHER THAN DECLARATION  every block puts its street in the same place  ⚠ WHICH IS PRECISELY WHAT PACKAGE-FORMAT-01 4 CRITICISES NWN FOR. So this is A PLACE NOT TO COPY: CORRIDOR SECTIONS AND JUNCTIONS GENUINELY NEED EDGES THAT MATCH, CITY BLOCKS ONLY HAD TO SIT SIDE BY SIDE, AND DAGGERFALL HAS NO ANSWER TO LEND. A DECLARED EDGE VOCABULARY IS OURS TO INVENT.

CONTENTS AND SHAPE ARE SPLIT ACROSS TWO FILES: the block carries shape AND props, the location carries the instances. ⚠ THAT IS THE SAME SEAM WE DREW INDEPENDENTLY  AREA-FORMAT-01 3s template path versus per-instance tag, and PACKAGE-NAMING-01s path versus tag. DAGGERFALL PUT IT IN THE SAME PLACE. And the lesson for prefabs: A PREFAB MAY CARRY PROPS, BUT ANYTHING THAT DIFFERS BETWEEN TWO STAMPINGS MUST LIVE ON THE STAMPING.

⚠⚠ AND DOORS, WHERE THREE GAMES DISAGREE USEFULLY. DAGGERFALL PUTS DOORS ON THE LOCATION  a UInt32 count then that many EIGHT-BYTE RECORDS, confirmed by arithmetic that only works one way. AURORAS DESCENDANT MAKES A DOOR A FULL BLUEPRINT: 104 UTDs ship in K2 and one sample carries FIFTY-SIX FIELDS  nine lock fields, seven damage, seven trap, three saves, AND SIXTEEN SCRIPT HOOKS. OURS IS A connections ENTRY WITH NO LOCK AT ALL.

⚠ AND ITS READING OF THE SPREAD IS THE FINDING: EIGHT BYTES AGAINST FIFTY-SIX FIELDS IS NOT A DISAGREEMENT ABOUT DOORS, IT IS A DISAGREEMENT ABOUT WHAT A GAME IS. Daggerfalls door is A HOLE WITH A FLAG because its doors exist to move you between an exterior and an interior GENERATED SEPARATELY. Auroras door is CONTENT  locked, trapped, scripted, opened by a key an author placed three areas away. WE ARE BUILDING THE SECOND KIND AND HAVE WRITTEN THE FIRST.

AND IT DECLINES TO COPY THE UTD FOR THE RIGHT REASON: FIFTY-SIX FIELDS ON A DOOR IS THE SAME DISEASE AS THE 112-FIELD CREATURE, and SIXTEEN SCRIPT HOOKS IS AURORAS EVENT MODEL NOT OURS  PLAY-STATE-01 makes state a projection of a log, SO OnOpen IS AN EVENT KIND, NOT A FIELD.

⚠⚠ AND IT CAUGHT OUR OWN FORMAT NAMING SOMETHING IT CANNOT MODEL. AREA-FORMAT-01 5 PREDICTED THIS IN ITS OWN WORDS  THIS IS THE RULE MOST LIKELY TO BE BROKEN FIRST, BECAUSE A DOOR HAS AN OBVIOUS OPEN-CLOSED  and 4s OWN EXAMPLE IS NAMED door.command-deck.aft. THE FORMAT NAMES IT A DOOR WHILE MODELLING ONLY ITS CONNECTION HALF. Its warning: A FORMAT THAT NAMES A THING A DOOR AND CANNOT LOCK IT WILL GROW A LOCK FIELD IN THE FIRST PACKAGE THAT NEEDS ONE, IN WHICHEVER PLACE THAT AUTHOR FOUND CONVENIENT.

## PT-1367 — PAINTING, ART AND PREFABS: ONE SYSTEM, THREE SIZES. ⚠ A PREFAB IS A SAVED SELECTION, AND IT PASTES RATHER THAN OVERLAYS

Owner designed the tile-authoring model. The verb stays Paint  confirmed three separate times by TRACE-16, TRACE-104 and TRACE-106  and WHAT CHANGES IS THE PAYLOAD AND THE SIZE.

PAINT WORKS ON A REGION: drag a box and the rectangle fills. A 3x4 OF FLOOR IS ONE GESTURE rather than forty clicks.

TEXTURES ARE 1x1 WITH VARIANTS. ⚠ AND OWNER CAUGHT THE REPETITION PROBLEM BEFORE IT WAS RAISED  a big floor tiled from one image looks obviously tiled. SOLVED THE WAY TRACE-95 FOUND DAGGERFALL SOLVING IT: SEEDED, NOT RE-ROLLED. A tileset ships three or four floors and THE ENGINE PICKS ONE FROM A HASH OF THE TILES POSITION  SAME SQUARE, SAME VARIANT, FOREVER. Varied without shimmering, at a cost of four drawings instead of one.

⚠⚠ AND THE LOAD-BEARING RULE: MULTI-TILE ART IS PIXELS ONLY AND NEVER DECIDES WHAT A SQUARE IS. A cargo-bay image spanning twelve squares changes HOW THEY LOOK AND NOTHING ELSE.

IF ART DECLARED TILE TYPES, TWO TRUTHS WOULD EXIST ABOUT ONE SQUARE  what the map says and what the art claims  AND EVERY ONE OF WHICH-WINS, WHAT-HAPPENS-ON-DELETE AND WHAT-HAPPENS-WHEN-TWO-OVERLAP BECOMES A RULE TO WRITE AND A BUG TO FIND. THE MAP IS THE SINGLE ANSWER.

⚠ AND THE PLAYER-FACING VERSION IS THE ARGUMENT THAT SETTLED IT: WHAT YOU SEE IS WHAT THE BOARD IS. A SQUARE THAT LOOKS LIKE FLOOR IS FLOOR, SO NOBODY EVER ASKS WHY CANT I WALK THERE  the question that ruins a tabletop app, BECAUSE ITS ANSWER LIVES IN A FILE THEY CANNOT SEE.

⚠ ART SNAPS TO THE GRID, WHICH WAS OWNERS ADDITION AND IT FIXES THE COST OF PIXELS-ONLY. It cannot land half a square off or be sized to a fraction of a tile. THE OBJECTION  PAINT FIRST, THEN PLACE ART  MOSTLY DISSOLVES WHEN ART CAN ONLY LAND ON SQUARES THAT ALREADY EXIST. And the Builder can then TELL YOU WHEN IT DOES NOT FIT, because it knows both. Grid-locked art also ROTATES IN QUARTER-TURNS, per TRACE-107s finding that Daggerfalls rotation is TWO BITS, FOUR VALUES ACROSS ALL 920 BLOCKS.

⚠⚠ AND THE PIECE THAT MAKES IT ONE SYSTEM IS OWNERS: A PREFAB IS A SAVED SELECTION. Paint a room, drop art on it, select it, save it  IT IS NOW IN THE PALETTE AND ANYONE CAN DRAG IT INTO ANY MAP.

SO A PREFAB IS NOT A SEPARATE AUTHORED THING WITH ITS OWN FORMAT. IT IS WHAT AN AUTHOR ALREADY MADE, KEPT. That is the stated accessibility goal exactly: PREMADE ROOMS FOR PEOPLE WHO DO NOT WANT TO PAINT ONE, MADE BY PEOPLE WHO DID.

⚠ AND A PREFAB DOES CARRY TILE TYPES, WHICH DOES NOT BREAK THE PIXELS-ONLY RULE, BECAUSE A PREFAB PASTES RATHER THAN OVERLAYS. STAMPING WRITES TILES INTO THE MAP AND THEN THE PREFAB IS GONE  what remains is tiles and art, EXACTLY AS IF PAINTED BY HAND. NO LIVE LAYER, NO SECOND SOURCE OF TRUTH, NO DELETE SEMANTICS.

And PT-1361 still holds throughout: a prefab carries ART AND TILES FROM OUR FIXED VOCABULARY, NEVER A RULE  so a strangers room cannot break your game.
